It was released as a [[Rare Bey Get Battle (Burst)|Rare Bey Get Battle]] Prize Booster in Japan in August 2015. In the toyline, it is succeeded by [[Shadow Amaterios 0 Xtreme']] and [[Shining Amaterios Aero'Angle Anchor]]. ==Layer - Amaterios== {{Part|Layer - Amaterios}} ==Disc - Aero== {{Part|Disc - Aero}} ==Driver - Assault== {{Part|Driver - Assault}} ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Takara Tomy==== a a a platina.jpg|Amaterios Aero Assault (Platinum Version) a a a dark.jpg|Amaterios Aero Assault (Dark Version) Amatarios Christmas.jpg|Amaterios (Christmas Version) ===Concept Art=== BB-Amaterios CA.jpg|Amaterios concept art. ===Anime === Anime Amaterios.jpg ===Manga=== ==Trivia== * Amaterios' name is a portmanteau of ''Amaterasu'', a Shinto goddess, and ''Helios'', a god in Greek mythology. Coincidentally, both Amaterasu and Helios have some relation to the sun, with Amaterasu being goddess of the sun in Shinto religion and Helios being revered as the personification of the sun. * The Platinum Version makes an appearance in episode 31 of the ''Beyblade Burst'' anime as a display in a museum. ** Amaterios is the only Single Layer Beyblade to appear in the anime. * Amaterios, along with its Disc and Driver, are the only Single Layer parts to never be released by Hasbro. ** A ''QuadDrive'' variant of the Assault Driver, [[Driver - Assault-Q|Assault-Q]], was released by Hasbro in 2022. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Beyblades}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Takara Tomy Exclusives]]

parts.title: Burst System
parts.text:
The '''Burst System''' is the Beyblade system released as part of the ''[[Beyblade Burst]]'' toyline. All Beyblade Burst products currently released belong to this system. As the name implies, the Burst System includes a gimmick where a Beyblade can "burst" into individual parts during a battle, adding an extra way to achieve victory.

The Burst System also has several subsystems, the first two being functionally similar between Takara Tomy and Hasbro releases:
* The '''[[List of Burst System parts|Dual Layer System]]''', which focuses on Beyblades with [[Layer]]s that have been split into two layers.
* The '''[[List of God Layer System parts|God Layer System]]/[[List of SwitchStrike System parts|SwitchStrike System]]''', which incorporates gimmicks into each Beyblade.

Takara Tomy subsequently released the following four subsystems:
* The '''[[List of Cho-Z Layer System parts|Cho-Z Layer System]]''', which incorporates metal in the [[Layer]]s.
* The '''[[List of Gatinko Layer System parts|Gatinko Layer System]]''', which introduces Beyblades whose [[Layer]]s are made up of three interchangeable parts.
* The '''[[List of Superking Layer System parts|Superking Layer System]]''', which introduces Beyblades whose [[Layer]]s are made up of three interchangeable parts, as well as introducing Double [[Chassis]], which can replace Discs.
* The '''[[List of Dynamite Battle Layer System parts|Dynamite Battle Layer System]]''', which introduces Beyblades whose [[Layer]]s are made up of three interchangeable parts, as well as introducing two modes for the Layers, "High Mode" and "Low Mode".
* The '''[[List of Dynamite Battle Layer System parts|Burst Ultimate Layer Series]]''', which introduces the "BU Blade", a new version of Blades that feature gimmicks.

In addition to these, there are four Hasbro exclusive subsystems that replace the aforementioned Cho-Z, Gatinko, Superking, and Dynamite Battle Layer Systems:
* The '''[[List of SlingShock System parts|SlingShock System]]''', which focuses on lightweight Layers and Discs, and a mode-changing gimmick to the [[Drivers]] that allows the Beyblades to move at high speeds along a "Rail System".
* The '''[[List of HyperSphere System parts|HyperSphere System]]''', which is based off of the Gatinko Layer System, which focuses on bulky Drivers that allow the Beyblades to "climb" and drop down from the Vertical Wall and Brink of a HyperSphere Beystadium to counterattack the opponent at high speeds.
* The '''[[List of SpeedStorm System parts|SpeedStorm System]]''', which is based on the Superking Layer System, and uses tall Drivers to utilize "Power Vortex" zones of a SpeedStorm Beystadium to gain a "speed boost".
* The '''[[List of QuadDrive System parts|QuadDrive System]]''', which is based on the Dynamite Battle Layer System, introduces Beyblades with two modes for the Layers, "Apex Mode" and "Core Mode", and two modes for the Drivers, "Normal Mode" and "Plus Mode". This creates a total of "4 ways to customize" a QuadDrive System Beyblade.
* The '''[[List of QuadDrive System parts|QuadStrike System]]''', which is based on the Burst Ultimate Layer Series, introduces the "QuadStrike Armor Tip", a new version of Armor Tips.
* The '''[[List of Pro Series System parts|Pro Series System]]''', which is comprised of Hasbro releases of various repackaged Takara Tomy Beyblades from the Cho-Z, Gatinko, and Superking Layer Systems. Beginning in 2023 with the Superking Layer System releases, the Takara Tomy logo is now displayed on the packaging.

==Structure==
The basic structure of a Burst System Beyblade consists of three main components: the Layer (Energy Layer), the Disc (Forge Disc), and the Driver (Performance Tip).

===Layer===
'''Layers''' (known as '''Energy Layers''' by Hasbro) are the part on the top of the Beyblade that makes all the contact with opposing Beyblades. Typically, a Layer is made of a texturized transparent casing with a colored piece screwed underneath, acting as a visualization of the weight distribution. Both components are made of polycarbonate (PC) plastic, but the bottom one is softer. In some cases, the colored segment protrudes from the sides or from the top through holes in the clear cover, in order to provide a little more shock absorption.

On the colored piece of plastic that is underneath, a ring is formed in the center to be able to see the Driver's letter through the hole, and also to house the Burst mechanism.

In Takara Tomy releases, the Layer also includes an NFC chip. This chip can be exclusively scanned at [[BeyTerminal]] arcade machines in Japan, allowing a Blader to play the virtual game and win prizes.

The Layer also includes a design that features the beast that it is based upon. For example, the [[Layer - Unicrest|Unicrest Layer]] includes the head of the unicorn within its design, and the horn serves as a contact point for the part.

Beginning with the Gatinko Layer System (Takara Tomy) and the HyperSphere System (Hasbro), Layers became more customizable with the Layer splitting into several parts.

===Disc===
'''Discs''' (known as '''Forge Discs''' by Hasbro) are the part in the middle of a Beyblade that serves as its weight. Discs are made of metal and are not designed to make contact with another Beyblade unless it is wobbling.

Discs come in various shapes and sizes, each having a different weight and distribution to suit a variety of needs. '''Core Discs''' are Discs that have the ability to attach [[Frames]] for further customization.

===Driver===
'''Drivers''' (known as '''Performance Tips''' by Hasbro) are the part at the bottom of a Beyblade that serves as its main form of movement and contact with the Beystadium floor.

Most of the Drivers released are of the same height, unlike in previous Beyblade series. They are shaped like an upside-down pyramid and house a spring system that is essential for the Burst mechanism thanks to the interaction of the white tabs at its top and the Layer's inner sets of tee

}}{{Translation|'''Aero'''|エアロ|Earo}}, stylized as '''αero''', is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-00α Booster, [[Amaterios Aero Assault]], in August 2015.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Aero''' is a slim, rounded pentagonal Disc composed of five downward sloping blades, akin to a reversed [[Disc - Wing|Wing]], meant to create Down Force in Right-Spin and Upper Force in Left-Spin. However, like Wing, '''Aero'''<nowiki/>'s slimness makes it far too light to be useful in any type of Combination and the blades are too shallow to create any noticeable Down/Upper Force effect. '''Aero''' is notable for being the only Disc to receive no equivalent release by [[Hasbro]].</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
'''Aero''' functions identically to [[Disc - Wing|Wing]] with the same negligible Down/Upper Force effect and crippling light weight.

'''As such, Aero is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Roktavor and Nepstrius Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc with high Defensive power and a tall wall-like shape that extends outward to block enemy attacks. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Armed''' is a symmetrical Disc with six round shield-like protrusions and engravings along with two bumps on either side that make room for the Disc's slots. While it has a bulky appearance implying a heavy weight, in reality it is actually very light due to how hollow it is. '''Armed'''’s lightness gave it the greatest Burst Resistance of any Disc at the time while the relatively smooth surface reduced recoil when struck if paired with a Performance Tip with poor Stability. However, this same lightness severely reduced Knock-Out Defense and Stamina as a trade-off. ==Overall== '''At the time of release, Armed was a decent Disc for Burst Defense Combinations. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-34 Starter, [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]], on April 2nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A lightweight Disc that can amplify the Driver's performance by firmly grounding the stadium with its six wings that produce intense downforce. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Boost''' is a circular Forge-Disc with six small downward sloping blades present around its perimeter. In theory, the blades are meant to produce Down Force in Right-Spin to increase the grip of the Beyblade on the stadium floor by pushing air downward and create Upper Force in Left-Spin which would decrease the friction between the Beyblade and the stadium floor by pushing air upwards. In reality however, due to the small size of the blades, the Down/Upper Force created is negligible and the said blades serve no other purposes other than drastically reducing the Life-After-Death of '''Boost'''. Furthermore, '''Boost''' has a light weight even for a non-Core Disc and a poor weight distribution making it a poor choice for Attack, Defense and Stamina Combinations. ==Overall== '''Boost''' is severely outclassed by other Discs such as [[Disc - 4|4]] and [[Disc - 7|7]] for Attack, Defense and Stamina due to its light weight and negligible Down/Upper Force effect.  '''As such, Boost is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-34 [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] * B-38 [[Beyblade Burst Entry Set]] - [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] * B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] - 02: [[Storm Spriggan Boost Yielding]] * B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] - 07: [[Rising Ragnaruk Boost Press]] * B-62 [[Dual Cyclone Beystadium DX Set]] - [[Fang Fenrir Boost Jaggy]] * B-64 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Heavy Ver.]] - [[Storm Spriggan Boost Impact]] * B-00 [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] (Flame Knight Ver.) * B-00 [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] (G1 Bronze Ver.) * B-00 [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] (G1 Silver Ver.) * B-00 [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] (G1 Gold Ver.) * B-00 [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] (Kirin Limited Campaign Green Ver.) Due to these gaps, '''Bumper''' is very lightweight and ill-suited for Knock-Out Defense or Attack and the rough perimeter makes it ill-suited for Stamina as well due to its poor Life-After-Death. While the light weight can bolster Burst Resistance, other Discs such as [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]] can do the same with greater Stamina.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
'''Bumper''' has a weight too light for Attack or Defense and too rough of a perimeter for Stamina. The Burst Resistance it can grant is niche and numerous other Discs such as [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]] and [[Disc - Down|Down]] can grant equal Burst Resistance and greater Stamina.

B9493 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=20 grams |System=Burst System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=July 18th, 2015 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=1 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=3 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Central'''|セントラル|Sentoraru}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-04 Starter, [[Kerbeus Central Defense (Takara Tomy)|Kerbeus Central Defense]], on July 18th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Spryzen and Odax Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = By placing the center of gravity in the center, the Disc prevents the axis from shaking, even when attacked. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Central''' features a thickened central ring and a thinned perimeter meant to create Centralized Weight Distribution (CWD). The centralized weight is meant to increase spin velocity which has numerous effects on performance: If used on Attack Combinations, the higher spin velocity will increase the force of impact. If used on Defense Combinations, the centralized weight will increase Knock-Out Resistance. While '''Central''' has an indent on once side to prevent this Disc from being perfectly balanced, it is not the main downfall of this Disc. What prevents this Disc from being competitive is the light weight which makes any effect from the Centralized Weight Distribution (CWD) negligible at best as there is too little mass for effective Attack potential and too little mass for effective Knock-Out Resistance. ==Overall== '''Central''' is simply too light for its intended Centralized Weight Distribution (CWD) to have any meaningful effect, making it outclassed by [[Disc - Yell|Yell]], an already outclassed part. parts.title: Disc - Down
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=DiskDown.png |Name=Down |JPName=ダウン |RomajiName=Daun |AKA=D |HasbroCode=D15 |ProductCode=B-56 (Takara Tomy)
C0598 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=20.5 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=August 6th, 2016 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=2 |StaminaStat=1 |WeightStat=1 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStat= |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Down'''|ダウン|Daun}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-56 Booster, [[Unlock Unicorn Down Needle]], on August 6th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Dark Doomscizor D2 and Uber Unicrest U2 Dual Pack|Dark Doomscizor D2 and Über Unicrest U2 Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc that lowers its center of gravity as much as possible to increase the stability of the Bey. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Down''' features a dropping shape akin to [[Disc - Armed|Armed]] and [[Disc - Vertical|Vertical]] with thin bands that connect the interior of the Disc with the weighted nubs along the bottom portion. Like all other Discs, it features two tabs with stylized 'D's that protrude from the top to fit into the slots of an Energy Layer. '''Down''''s design is meant to lower the center of gravity on a Beyblade, doing so increases a Beyblade's Stability and reduces the risk of floor scrapes. In addition, the wide shape of '''Down''' focuses much of its weight around the perimeter, giving this Disc excellent Stamina properties and giving Attack Combinations greater aggressive movements with its Flywheel Effect. However, '''Down''' has two features that give both advantages and disadvantages: The first is weight, '''Down''''s average weight means that its Knock-Out Defense is sub-par compared to more popular choices such as [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] or [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]], but at the same time gives more Burst Defense than the aforementioned Discs. The second is height and shape, while excellent for Stability and Stamina, the weighted nubs create a rough perimeter and the low positioning makes it easy for said nubs to contact the stadium floor late in battle when spin velocity is low, rendering any Life-After-Death null. However, the low center of gravity helps resist listing and Destabilization to prevent such contact. ==Overall== While [[Disc - Spread|Spread]]'s shape may give Life-After-Death, '''Down''' offers greater Stability and comparable Stamina mid battle. While [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] or [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] offer greater Knock-Out Resistance throughout a whole battle without the penalty of Stamina, '''Down''' offers greater Burst Resistance and comparable aggressive movements in Attack Combinations. However, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer Core Discs and Disc Frames, '''Down''' is no longer viable in the current metagame. '''As such, Down is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-56 [[Unlock Unicorn Down Needle]] * B-65 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Speed Ver.]] - [[Kaiser Kerbeus Down Orbit]] (blue) * B-67 [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]] - 04: [[Xeno Xcalibur Down Orbit]] ===Hasbro=== * C0598 [[Dark Doomscizor D2 and Uber Unicrest U2 Dual Pack|Dark Doomscizor D2 and Über Unicrest U2 Dual Pack]] - [[Uber Unicrest U2 Down Needle|Über Unicrest U2 Down Needle]] * C2282 [[Uber Unicrest U2 Down Needle|Über Unicrest U2 Down Needle]] * E1054 [[Beast Betromoth B2 Down Liner]] * E2757 [[Raging Roktavor R2 Down Spiral]] * E9409 [[Extreme Challenger Battle Set]] - [[Erase Balkesh B5 Down Rise-H]] * F2302 [[Demise Satomb S6 and Atlas Anubion A6 Dual Pack]] - [[Demise Satomb S6 Down Destroy-SPM]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DiskDown.png|Down (Multiple releases) ===Hasbro=== DiscDownRender.png|Down (Multiple releases; Official Render) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

parts.title: Disc - Force
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=DiskForce.png |Name=Force |JPName=フォース |RomajiName=Fōsu |AKA=F |HasbroCode=D11 |ProductCode=B-23 (Takara Tomy)
C0596 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=19.2 grams |System=Burst System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=December 26th, 2015 |ReleaseUS=February 2017 |AttackStat=2 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=1 |SpeedStat=1 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Force'''|フォース|Fōsu}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-23 Starter, [[Xcalibur Force Xtreme]], on December 26th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Raging Roktavor R2 and Xcalius Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc that can be used to attack by concentrating its weight to the four corners of its square shape. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Force''' is a symmetrical Disc that has a diamond or plus-like shape. Its design consists of four main armor-like protrusions; two of which are behind the Disc's prongs, and the other two are on the opposites sides and are fully exposed. Such shape has two uses: The first is to increase the weight of a Beyblade's attacks via aligning with the Layer's protrusions, such as the golem heads of [[Layer - Gigant Gaia|Gigant Gaia]] or the small square-like protrusions of [[Layer - Storm Spriggan|Storm Spriggan]]. The second use is to balance out imbalanced Layers such as [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] by aligning with the Layer's contact points as it grows halfway to Bursting. This effect also allows Combinations to have increased Stamina and Burst Resistance. While this may imply that '''Force''' is top-tier for Attack Combinations, it weighs less than [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] and [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]], despite its rather heavy appearance. This also limits its use in Stamina Combinations, as its aggressive design reduces Stamina and can throw the Combination off balance, increasing the risk of Bursts. Due to these drawbacks, '''Force''' is rendered outclassed and ill-suited for all types of Combinations. ==Overall== While the aggressive design of '''Force''' makes it useful in Attack Combinations, [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] and [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] perform better and also improve on its weaknesses. Furthermore, with the release of heavier Disc such as [[Disc - 0|0]] and [[Disc - 7|7]], '''Force''' has become too light to be competitive. '''As such, unless one prefers to use Force, it is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-23 [[Xcalibur Force Xtreme]] * B-42 [[Dark Deathscyther Force Jaggy]] * B-00 [[Xcalibur Force Xtreme]] (Gold Ver.) parts.text:
{{About|Gravity|Disc - Gravity-L|its Rip Fire counterpart}} {{Part Infobox |Image=DiskGravity.png |Name=Gravity |JPName=グラビティ |RomajiName=Gurabiti |AKA=G |HasbroCode=D03 |ProductCode=B-36 (Takara Tomy)
B9489 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=21.6 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=April 2nd, 2016 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=1 |WeightStat=4 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Gravity'''|グラビティ|Gurabiti}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-36 Booster, [[Rising Ragnaruk Gravity Revolve]], on April 2nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Raging Roktavor R2 Gravity Revolve]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc that can generate tremendous centrifugal force from its thick and heavy design. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Gravity''' has a thick, octagonal shape and bears designs that resemble steel plates on each of its eight segments. As with all Discs, it has two tabs that protrude from the top and fit in the slots in the Energy Layer. These tabs are marked with a stylized G to identify the Disc. '''Gravity''' was tied with [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] for the heaviest Disc in the game, making it a solid choice for adding weight to the Beyblade and increasing its Knock-Out Defense. Compared to the rather compact [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]], '''Gravity''' has a larger diameter and more of its weight packed around its perimeter, giving it arguably what was the best Stamina in the game and increasing the mobility of more aggressive Combinations with the Flywheel Effect. However, it has been outclassed by [[Disc - 7|7]] for Stamina. The high spin momentum provided by '''Gravity''''s Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) means that the overall Beyblade will not lose much spin upon collision with an opponent, however that means that the force of the impact will instead be absorbed by the Energy Layer, causing it to skip teeth to cope with the shock. ==Use in Balance Combinations== '''Gravity''' can be used in the Defense/Stamina Hybrid, [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]] '''Gravity''' [[Driver - Defense|Defense]]. '''Gravity''' increases the Stamina and Knock-Out Defense of the Combination compared to other Discs like [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] or [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]], while [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]] has enough Burst Defense capabilities to overcompensate for '''Gravity'''’s increased risk of Bursting. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== As '''Gravity''' possesses some of, what was, the highest raw Stamina in the game, it can be used on the Pure Stamina Combination [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] '''Gravity''' [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]. While this Combination was capable of Out-Spinning nearly any opponent, the use of '''Gravity''' in conjunction with [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] means that it also has very poor Burst Defense, making it a risky yet effective choice. It also does not have the best Stamina anymore, due to being outclassed by Discs such as [[Disc - 7|7]] and [[Disc - 0|0]]. ==Overall== Being the one of the heaviest Discs available, in addition to having a unique design focusing on Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), '''Gravity''' was once a valuable asset to a blader's collection. However with the release of Core Discs and Disc Frames, '''Gravity''' has become outclassed. parts.title: Disc - Heavy
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=DiskHeavy.png |Name=Heavy |JPName=ヘビー |RomajiName=Hebī |AKA=H |HasbroCode=D07 |ProductCode=B-03 (Takara Tomy)
B9496 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=21.6 grams |System=Burst System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=July 18th, 2015 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=4 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Heavy'''|ヘビー|Hebī}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-03 Starter, [[Ragnaruk Heavy Survive]], on July 18th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Roktavor and Nepstrius Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A heavyweight Disc with four heavy weights that create stability and high Defense. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Heavy''' is a primarily circular Disc, sporting a ring-like shape with numerous ridges on its interior that is interrupted by four rectangular protrusions designed to look like armored plates. As its name suggests, '''Heavy''' was the heaviest Disc in the Burst System for a considerable period of time, until [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]], which also weighs 21.6 grams, and [[Disc - Quarter|Quarter]], which weighs 21.8 grams were released. Despite this, '''Heavy''' is still one of the heaviest Discs in the game, making it a popular choice for many Bladers. As its weight is a welcome asset to nearly any Beyblade, it enjoys a wide variety of uses on Combinations of all types. '''Heavy''''s high weight and compact shape gives it a Centralized Weight Distribution (CWD), making it particularly useful for Burst Attack as it will maximize the RPM of the Beyblade. This same weight distribution also makes it considerably more difficult to Burst than [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]], the other disc in its weight class, at the cost of a significant amount of Stamina. Because of this, it is a better option for a Knock-Out Defense Combination than [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] as Knock-Out Defense Combinations rely on high friction and weight to remain in the stadium, at the same time increasing their vulnerability to Bursting. However, due to its weight, '''Heavy''' is still more prone to Bursting than most lighter competitive Discs such as [[Disc - Spread|Spread]], [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]], and [[Disc - Armed|Armed]]. ==Use in Attack Combinations== '''Heavy''' can be used in both the Knock-Out Attack Combination [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] and the Burst Attack Combination [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Yielding|Yielding]]. Both of these Combinations benefit from '''Heavy''''s weight and weight distribution as it puts more force behind attacks in the case of the former, and maximizes the combo's RPM in the case of the latter. ==Use in Defense Combinations== As '''Heavy''''s weight generally makes it a poor choice for Burst Defense, it has found use in the Combination [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]. This combo has a solid mix of Knock-Out Defense and Burst Defense, while also having moderate amounts of Stamina. Alternatively, '''Heavy''' can also be used in the Knock-Out Defense Combination [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Unite|Unite]]. While this Combination is incredibly difficult to Knock-Out due to '''Heavy''' and [[Driver - Unite|Unite]], and [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]] provides some insurance against Bursting, it has poor Stamina and should only be used against [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]-based Attack Combinations. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== While [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] and [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] are generally preferred over '''Heavy''' for Stamina purposes, '''Heavy''' can still be used to provide a passable performance in the Combinations [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]] and [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]. ==Use in Balance Combinations== '''Heavy''' can be used in the Destabilizer Combination [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]. As Destabilizer Combinations perform better when they are spinning at a higher RPM than their opponent, '''Heavy''''s weight distribution helps [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]] Destabilize opponents more effectively. Alternatively, '''Heavy''' can be used in the Burst Defense/Stamina Hybrid [[Layer - Odin|Odin]] '''Heavy''' [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]]. Due to the weight, weight distribution, and shape of the [[Layer - Odin|Odin]] Layer, this Combination performs much like the compacts of the Plastics era and is difficult to Burst or Out-Spin. ==Overall== '''Heavy''' was once one of the heaviest Discs in the game along with [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] and [[Disc - Quarter|Quarter]] and was the most common choice in Defense and Stamina Combinations. However, with the release of Core Discs and Disc Frames, '''Heavy''' has become outclassed. '''As such, Heavy is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-03 [[Ragnaruk Heavy Survive]] * B-05 [[Spriggan Heavy Defense]] * B-15 [[Random Booster Vol. 1 Trident Heavy Claw]] - 01: [[Trident Heavy Claw]] * B-15 [[Random Booster Vol. 1 Trident Heavy Claw]] - 04: [[Kerbeus Heavy Survive]] * B-22 [[Beyblade Custom Set Defense & Stamina]] - [[Wyvern Heavy Survive]] (red painted) * B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] - 04: [[Wyvern Heavy Accel]] * B-61 [[Random Booster Vol. 4 Quad Quetzalcoatl.J.P]] - 08: [[Driger Slash Heavy Fusion (Takara Tomy)|Driger Slash Heavy Fusion]] * B-63 [[Beast Behemoth Heavy Hold]] * B-90 [[3on3 Battle Booster Set]] - [[Guardian Kerbeus Heavy Revolve]] * B-125 [[Random Booster Vol. 12 Dead Hades.11T

C2356 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=20.0 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=September 17th, 2016 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=1 |StaminaStat=2 |WeightStat=1 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Infinity'''|インフィニティ|Infiniti}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-59 Starter, [[Zillion Zeus Infinity Weight]], on September 17th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Zillion Zeutron Z2 Infinity Weight]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = By smoothly connecting the front and back surfaces, Infinity reduces air resistance and creates centrifugal force. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Infinity''' features a round, thick, sharp edged and warped design meant to recreate the look of a Mobius Strip. Like [[Disc - Ring|Ring]], almost all of '''Infinity''''s weight is focused on the perimeter creating a high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and Flywheel Effect for Stamina Combinations and the round design allows for some Life-After-Death. However, like [[Disc - Ring|Ring]], the high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) increases the risk of Bursts as the Disc and Performance Tip will resist changes in spin speed while the Layer is more likely to stop, leading to teeth skipping and Bursts. ==Use in Tornado Staller Combinations== Due to '''Infinity''''s poor Burst Resistance, it performs best in the Tornado Staller Combination [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]]/[[Layer - Acid Anubis|Acid Anubis]]/[[Layer - Zillion Zeus|Zillion Zeus]] '''Infinity''' [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]. The high Outward Weight Distribution of '''Infinity''' and the low friction of [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] allows Combinations to Out-Spin Stationary Combinations without coming into contact with them. ==Overall== Due to '''Infinity''''s high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), a Combination using it is able to better maintain its Stamina after impact but is also more susceptible to Bursts as a result. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God System Core Discs such as [[Disc - 4|4]] and [[Disc - 7|7]], '''Infinity''' has become heavily outclassed in the current metagame. C3180 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=19.4 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=October 22nd, 2016 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=3 |StaminaStat=1 |WeightStat=1 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStat= |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Jerk'''|ジャーク|Jāku}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-61 [[Random Booster Vol. 4 Quad Quetzalcoatl.J.P]] on October 22nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Quill Quetziko Q2 Jerk Press]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc with elastic plastic parts equipped on its outer circumference that absorbs and bounces off of the opponent's attack. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Jerk''' is a round, thick and symmetrical Disc that features a round perimeter made of soft plastic that's attached to the Disc via screws, akin to [[Disc - Magnum|Magnum]] and [[Disc - Polish|Polish]]. The soft plastic perimeter features two shield-like bumpers that are placed behind the Disc's prongs. Unlike most Discs, '''Jerk''' features a "Bound Defense" gimmick; in this case, the bumpers are designed to push inwards. Upon impact, during Disc-to-Layer contact, the bumpers will theoretically bend inwards to absorb the shock of the impact and reduce recoil. In practice, this gimmick is rather dysfunctional. First, due to how rare Disc-to-Layer contact occurs, '''Jerk''' will rarely make contact with the opponent. Second, '''Jerk '''is rather hollow, creating poor Stamina despite the Disc being round in shape. Lastly, the soft plastic bumpers hardly have any flexibility. This, combined with the Disc's short distance between the stadium floor makes '''Jerk''' unsuitable for Defense and Stamina Combinations. ==Overall== The design of the Burst System makes Disc-to-Layer contact between '''Jerk''' and the opponent's Layer rare, the hollow design of the soft plastic heavily reduces Stamina, the thick shape of the Disc makes scraping common, its weight is too light to be used in Defense Combinations, and the force needed to make its Bound Defense gimmick work is simply too high to happen in battle, making '''Jerk''' completely worthless. '''As such, unless one prefers to use Jerk, it is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-61 [[Random Booster Vol. 4 Quad Quetzalcoatl.J.P]] - 01: [[Quad Quetzalcoatl Jerk Press]] (blue plastic) * B-61 [[Random Booster Vol. 4 Quad Quetzalcoatl.J.P]] - 02: [[Wild Wyvern Jerk Gyro]] * B-61 [[Random Booster Vol. 4 Quad Quetzalcoatl.J.P]] - 03: [[Dark Deathscyther Jerk Orbit]] (pale green plastic) * B-67 [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]] - 05: [[Nova Neptune Jerk Impact]] (red plastic) ===Hasbro=== * C3180 [[Quetziko Q2 Jerk Press]] * F0615 [[Super Satomb S6 Jerk Zone-SP]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DiskJerk.png|Jerk (B-61 01) ===Hasbro=== Jerk (F0615).png|Jerk (F0615) Jerk (F0615; Render).png|Jerk (F0615; Official Render) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

{{About|Knuckle|Disc - Knuckle-L|its Rip Fire counterpart}} {{Part Infobox |Image=DiskKnuckle.png |Name=Knuckle |JPName=ナックル |RomajiName=Nakkuru |AKA=K |HasbroCode=D02 |ProductCode=B-35 (Takara Tomy)
B9488 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=20.2 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=April 2nd, 2016 |AttackStat=1 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=1 |WeightStat=2 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Knuckle'''|ナックル|Nakkuru}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-35 Starter, [[Storm Spriggan Knuckle Unite]], on April 2nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A wide Disc that has a large diameter and centrifugal force that can improve a Beyblade's Attack power by gathering the center of gravity from its six outer points. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Knuckle''' is a circular Disc with six notches around the perimeter and four holes near the center of the Disc. The letter "K" is written on its prongs for easy differentiation from other Discs. Due to the holes in the Disc, most of the weight of '''Knuckle''' is focused around its perimeter giving it high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) which results in excellent Stamina properties. However, it lags behind other Discs like [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] and [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] in terms of Stamina potential. Although, one advantage '''Knuckle''' holds over the aforementioned Discs is increased Burst Resistance which only falls behind [[Disc - Down|Down]] and [[Disc - Armed|Armed]], both of which suffer from scraping issues and low Stamina respectively. Due to its good Stamina, decent weight and high Burst Resistance, '''Knuckle''' was once an excellent Disc for all kinds of Combinations. However, '''Knuckle''' has since been outclassed by heavier Discs. Later releases of '''Knuckle''' by Hasbro, particularly the ones included with [[Poison Cyclops C5 Knuckle Guard-H]] and the [[Evolution Trio Spryzen 3-Pack]], are noticeably lighter, at about 18.5 grams compared to the 20.2 grams average. ==Overall== |-|Standard= '''Knuckle''' was an excellent Disc for all types of Combinations, but was subsequently outclassed by the heavier and more versatile Core Discs and Disc Frames. '''As such, Knuckle is recommended for collection purposes only.''' |-|Limited= '''Knuckle''' is outclassed by heavier Core Disc and Disc Frame combinations, as well as Discs released by Hasbro such as [[Disc - Wheel-SP|Wheel-SP]] and [[Disc - Tapered-Q|Tapered-Q]]. '''As such, Knuckle is recommended for collection purposes only.''' |-|Classic= '''Knuckle''' is a top-tier Disc in the WBO's Burst Classic Format, where its heavy weight and versatility makes it one of the strongest Discs in the format. '''As such, Knuckle is a must have for competitive bladers.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-35 [[Storm Spriggan Knuckle Unite]] * B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] - 03: [[Rising Ragnaruk Knuckle Yielding]] * B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] - 04: [[Kaiser Kerbeus Knuckle Revolve]] * B-00 [[Storm Spriggan Knuckle Unite]] (Emerald Ver.) It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-48 Starter, [[Xeno Xcalibur Magnum Impact]], on July 2nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of the Starter Pack, [[Inferno Ifritor I2 Magnum Liner]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc with a dissimilar material fused into it that has the largest outer diameter in its class and also increases Attack power with its three major contact points. |speaker = Official Description}} The '''Magnum''' Disc features a circular metal center component with a plastic perimeter covering the sides and some of the top. This leaves the metal directly on the bottom and the prongs that fit into the Layer still exposed. The covering features three triangular protrusions and one round protrusion. Unlike other Discs, the letter M is not located on the prongs as they are located on the plastic instead. '''Magnum''' is meant to distribute weight on three corners like [[Disc - Triple|Triple]], however, the lightweight outer plastic construction limits the effects of such a weight distribution. '''Magnum''' has a notable interaction with the [[Layer - Xeno Xcalibur|Xeno Xcalibur]] Layer: after two clicks, the protrusion of '''Magnum''' will line up with Xeno Xcalibur's sword protrusion contact point. ==Overall== While '''Magnum''''s triangular shape can create some synergy with the [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] line of Layers, the Disc's plastic construction makes it too light to be competitive. The part of the Disc that bulges out creates centrifugal force, allowing the Beyblade to unleash a powerful blow. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Oval''', like the name implies, is shaped like an oval. Os appear on the upper side of the Disc as well for easy recognition. In theory, '''Oval''' would provide extra momentum to the Beyblade's spin by spreading the weight at two opposite sides. However, its underside is mostly hollowed out, making it the second lightest Disc released, the first being [[Disc - 12|12]]. Its odd shape only ends up hindering the Beyblade's Stability, making the Combination using it precess dangerously the moment another Beyblade hits it. Even for Niche Combinations such as Hop Attackers using [[Driver - Quake|Quake]], '''Oval''' only poses a risk of Destabilization, and it cannot make up for it by any significant aid in Attack. ==Overall== '''As such, Oval is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-12 [[Deathscyther Oval Accel]] * B-21 [[Beyblade Custom Set Attack & Balance]] - [[Minoboros Oval Quake (Takara Tomy)|Minoboros Oval Quake]] * B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] - 07: [[Odin Oval Fusion]] * B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] - 08: [[Valkyrie Oval Needle]] * B-57 [[Triple Booster Set]] - [[Chaos Oval Gyro]] ===Hasbro=== * B9505 [[Doomscizor Oval Accel]] * C0707 [[Custom Clash Pack]] - [[Minoboros Oval Quake (Hasbro)|Minoboros Oval Quake]] * C0942 [[Minoboros Oval Quake (Hasbro)|Minoboros Oval Quake]] * C2358 [[Giga Gaianon G2 and Doomscizor Dual Pack]] - [[Doomscizor Oval Accel]] * E1064 [[Caynox and Wild Wyvron W2 Dual Pack]] - [[Caynox Oval Gyro]] * E9409 [[Extreme Challenger Battle Set]] - [[Glyph Pegasus P5 Oval Yard-H]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DiskOval.png|Oval (Multiple releases) ===Hasbro=== ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

parts.title: Disc - Polish
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=DiskPolish.png |Name=Polish |JPName=ポリッシュ |RomajiName=Porisshu |AKA=P |HasbroCode=D22 |ProductCode=B-65 (Takara Tomy)
E1058 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=20.5 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=November 12th, 2016 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=1 |StaminaStat=3 |WeightStat=1 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Polish'''|ポリッシュ|Porisshu}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-65 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Speed Ver.]] on November 12th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Phrenic Phantazus P2 Polish Edge]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc fused with other materials that creates a tenacious rotation by preventing the Beyblade's Layer from touching the stadium floor when the outer ring touches the ground after tilting. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Polish''', like [[Disc - Magnum|Magnum]] and [[Disc - Jerk|Jerk]], is a Disc made up of metal core and plastic perimeter with the letter, in this case "P", embossed onto the plastic on either side with the plastic making up the gimmick of the Disc. For '''Polish''''s gimmick, the plastic creates a "skirt" with a perfectly smooth and circular perimeter meant to, in theory, create high Life-After-Death so that a Stamina Combination can Out-Spin its opponent. In practice, the gimmick works as intended, however, a single factor restricts '''Polish''''s performance in Stamina Combinations; the plastic construction. Due to having a metal core and plastic perimeter, '''Polish''' has a Centralized Weight Distribution (CWD) rather than an Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) which creates poor spin retention and spin times making '''Polish''' Combinations liable to being Out-Spun. Furthermore, the same construction makes '''Polish''' very lightweight and makes Combinations highly vulnerable to Knock-Outs. However, the same lightweight allows '''Polish''' to be used to great effect in Spin-Equalization Combinations as the low weight creates low inertia and makes it easier for a '''Polish''' Combination to Spin-Equalize and the high Life-After-Death allows Spin-Equalization Combinations to Out-Spin their opponents by a few more rotations. ==Use in Spin-Equalization Combinations== '''Polish''' can be put to use in the Spin-Equalization Combination [[Layer - Drain Fafnir|Drain Fafnir]]/[[Layer - Spriggan Requiem|Spriggan Requiem]] '''Polish''' [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]]/[[Driver - Hold|Hold]]/[[Driver - Destroy|Destroy]]. The low weight of '''Polish''' works with the free-spinning and/or low friction nature of [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]]/[[Driver - Hold|Hold]]/[[Driver - Destroy|Destroy]] and the rubber of [[Layer - Drain Fafnir|Drain Fafnir]]/[[Layer - Spriggan Requiem|Spriggan Requiem]] to allow for high Spin-Equalization potential. The Life-After-Death of '''Polish''' is enhanced by the Life-After-Death of the free-spinning components of [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]]/[[Driver - Hold|Hold]]/[[Driver - Destroy|Destroy]] allowing the Combination to Out-Spin its opponent. However, even against Opposite-Spin opponents, '''Polish''' makes these Combinations liable to Knock-Outs against Attack Combinations. ==Overall== '''Polish''' is one of the better Discs for Spin-Equalization Combinations due to its light weight and high Life-After-Death. However, its light weight makes Combinations liable to Knock-Outs and Core Disc and Disc Frame Combinations such as [[Disc - 7|7]][[Frame - Cross|Cross]] are able to perform comparably without the Knock-Out risk. '''As such, Polish is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-65 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Speed Ver.]] - [[Psychic Phantom Polish Weight]] * B-80 [[Random Booster Vol. 6 Tornado Wyvern.4G.At]] - 03: [[Fang Fenrir Polish Atomic]] ===Hasbro=== * E1058 [[Phrenic Phantazus P2 Polish Edge]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DiskPolish.png|Polish (B-65) ===Hasbro=== DiskPolishHasbro.png|Polish (E1058) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

parts.title: Disc - Quarter
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=DiskQuarter.png |Name=Quarter |JPName=クオーター |RomajiName=Kuōtā |AKA=Q |HasbroCode=D21 |ProductCode=B-67 (Takara Tomy)
C2358 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=21.8 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=December 28th, 2016 |AttackStat=1 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=3 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Quarter'''|クオーター|Kuōtā}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-67 [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]] on December 28th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Giga Gaianon G2 and Doomscizor Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc that has a heavy weight that is divided into four major weight points that make its center of gravity biased. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Quarter''' is a Disc with a wide, round, pipe-like shape interrupted by four rounded rectangular protrusions, on one of the protrusions is a small, marked elevation that creates the look of the letter 'Q'. Like all Discs, it has two tabs that protrude from the top and fit in the slots in the Energy Layer. These tabs are marked with a stylized 'Q' for identification. '''Quarter''''s gimmick is that it is highly unbalanced, it achieves this by being mostly hollow on the underside, with the marked protrusion being half filled in with metal. A weight distribution like this has two primary uses. The first is to increase the Smash Attack of Attack Combinations as the unbalanced nature creates momentum like a flail, this is further enhanced by the weight of '''Quarter''' which is greater than [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] or [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]. However, the off-set weight distribution is too little to increase Attack potential meaningfully while also severely increasing the risk of Self-Bursts. The second is to make a Combination using an unbalanced layer, like [[Layer - Xcalius|Xcalibur]], more properly balanced by placing the heavier corner opposite the heavier side of the Layer which increases its Stamina and Burst Resistance. Furthermore, this same unbalanced nature makes '''Quarter''' unsuitable for Stamina and Defense Combinations as the more unbalanced a Beyblade is, the easier it is to Burst. ==Overall== Due to '''Quarter''' standing as one of the heaviest non-Core Discs in the game and as one of the most unbalanced, it has great synergy with Attack Types and other unbalanced parts. However, its gimmick makes Combination options with '''Quarter''' limited as well. Furthermore, with the release of [[Disc - 1|1]] and [[Disc - 1'|1']], '''Quarter''' has become outclassed in its niche use. parts.title: Disc - Ring
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=DiskRing.png |Name=Ring |JPName=リング |RomajiName=Ringu |AKA=R |HasbroCode=D09 |ProductCode=B-22 (Takara Tomy)
B9492 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=19.5 grams |System=Burst System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=November 14th, 2015 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=2 |WeightStat=2 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Ring'''|リング|Ringu}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-22 [[Beyblade Custom Set Defense & Stamina]] on November 14th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Valtryek and Unicrest Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc that creates a large centrifugal force by reducing its weight on its inside and placing a thick ring on its outside to create an outer center of gravity. |speaker = Official Description}} As its name suggests, '''Ring''' is a Disc with a smooth, solid ring that forms its perimeter. The ring is interrupted by 4 small designs that cause it to somewhat resemble a pipe. The ring is connected to the interior of the disk by two thin triangular structures, as well as the prongs that fit inside the Energy Layer. '''Ring''''s smooth perimeter provides the Beyblade with a small amount of Life-After-Death, allowing it to roll on the edge of the disc for a few extra rotations after falling over, making it useful for Stamina Combinations. Additionally, nearly all of '''Ring''''s weight is located on its perimeter, so it offers impressive Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and increases the Beyblade's Stamina significantly thanks to the Flywheel Effect. However, this weight distribution also has its downsides. As a Disc with high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) such as '''Ring''', it's more difficult to slow down while spinning, when colliding with an opponent, a Beyblade using '''Ring''' will not lose very much Stamina from the force of the impact. This force must go somewhere, though, and is usually absorbed by the Energy Layer instead, making it more likely to skip its teeth and Burst. Because of this, '''Ring''' is generally not recommended over Discs with similar Stamina but less of a tendency to Burst, such as [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] and [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== Because '''Ring''''s Burst Defense is rather poor, it performs best on a Tornado Staller such as [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] '''Ring''' [[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]. This Combination is able to Out-Spin several Stationary Combinations without coming into contact with them and risk being Burst. ==Overall== With its high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), '''Ring''' maintains its Stamina well when taking hits, but is largely susceptible to Bursting as a result. In addition, better alternatives exist, such as [[Disc - 4|4]] and [[Disc - 7|7]]. '''As such, Ring is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-22 [[Beyblade Custom Set Defense & Stamina]] - [[Unicorn Ring Defense]] * B-31 [[Yggdrasil Ring Gyro]] * B-95 [[Random Booster Vol. 8 Shelter Regulus.5S.Tw]] - [[Alter Chronos Ring Tower]] ===Hasbro=== * B9492 [[Valtryek and Unicrest Dual Pack]] - [[Unicrest Ring Defense]] * C0941 [[Unicrest Ring Defense]] * C0943 [[Yegdrion Ring Edge]] * E1053 [[Quill Quetziko Q2 Ring Edge]] * E7720 [[Cosmic Valtryek V5 Ring Trick-H]] * F0213 [[Wolborg Ring Prevail-S]] (Canceled) * F2300 [[Glide Dullahan D6 and Mad Minoboros M6 Dual Pack]] - [[Glide Dullahan D6 Ring Revolve-SPM]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DiskRing.png|Ring (Multiple releases) ===Hasbro=== DiscRingRender.png|Ring (Multiple releases; Official Render) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

{{About|Spread|Disc - Spread'|its Dash counterpart}} {{Part Infobox |Image=DiskSpread.png |Name=Spread |JPName=スプレッド |RomajiName=Supureddo |AKA=S |HasbroCode=D06 |ProductCode=B-02 (Takara Tomy)

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-02 DX Starter, [[Spriggan Spread Fusion]], on July 18th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of the [[Spryzen and Odax Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Disc with a streamlined shape and low air resistance due to centrifugal force caused by its large diameter. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Spread''' is a completely circular Disc, featuring a smooth perimeter and underside only interrupted by four small bumps located beneath the prongs, as well as several stylized blade designs on top. As with all Discs, the letter representing the Disc, in this case, S, is present on top of the prongs that fit into the Energy Layer. '''Spread''' has a significant amount of Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), and a relatively thin and aerodynamic shape, making it a viable choice for Stamina Combinations. Depending on which Performance Tip is used, '''Spread''' can also provide the combo with some Life-After-Death as it will roll along the stadium floor and give the Combination a few extra rotations after falling over, which can be crucial for Out Spinning an opponent.  For some time after its release, '''Spread''' was very useful in Stamina Combinations due to its weight distribution and its fair weight. However, as Bladers now have a wider array of competitively viable Discs to choose from, '''Spread''' has fallen out of use compared to options such as [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] and [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== '''Spread''' can be used on the Combination [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] '''Spread''' [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]. This combo has some of the highest raw Stamina in the metagame, enough so that it is even able to outspin Destabilizer Combinations using [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]] and [[Driver - Defense|Defense]]. Alternatively, '''Spread''' can work on a Tornado Staller Combination, such as [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] '''Spread''' [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]. The Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) of the Disc not only provides Stamina, but also helps the Combination remain on the Tornado Ridge for a longer period of time. ==Use in Balance Combinations== '''Spread''' can be used to create an Attack/Stamina Hybrid, [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] '''Spread''' [[Driver - Trans|Trans]]. [[Driver - Trans|Trans]]’ tip changing mechanism allows the Combination to switch between traditional Mobile Attack, Stationary Attack, and Tornado Stalling, making this Combination a very versatile choice that can overcome nearly any opponent in the hands of a skilled player. ==Overall== '''Spread''' was once an excellent choice for Stamina Combinations due to its Life-After-Death and weight distribution. However, it has since been heavily outclassed by Core Discs and Disc Frames. {{Part Infobox |Image=DiskYell.png |Name=Yell |JPName=エール |RomajiName=Ēru |AKA=Y |HasbroCode=D25 |ProductCode=B-71 (Takara Tomy)
E1057 (Hasbro) |Classification=Disc |Weight=21.2 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=February 18th, 2017 |ReleaseUS=November 2017 |ReleaseCA=November 2017 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=1 |WeightStat=3 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Yell'''|エール|Ēru}} is a [[Disc]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-71 Booster, [[Acid Anubis Yell Orbit]], on February 18th, 2017. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Atlas Anubion A2 Yell Orbit]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A defensive Disc that achieves both centrifugal force and an internal center of gravity by increasing its overall diameter and creating a frame-like structure on its outside. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Yell''' features a ring with a wide diameter, greater than [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] and equal to [[Disc - Polish|Polish]], and a thick metal star in the center to create a centralized weight, akin to [[Disc - Central|Central]]. The centralized weight is meant to increase spin velocity which has numerous effects on Performance: If used on Attack Combinations, the higher spin velocity will increase the force of impact. If used on Defense Combinations, the centralized weight will increase Knock-Out Resistance. Combined with the wide, circular perimeter and the raised position of the ring, '''Yell''' will also grant high Life-After-Death and increase Precession time. However, the centralized weight creates numerous drawbacks as well: The centralized weight will reduce movement speed in Attack Combinations making it ill-suited for Mobile Combinations and the lack of Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) gives Defense and Stamina Combinations poor spin retention. ==Overall== Due to this Disc's Centralized Weight Distribution (CWD) and wide diameter, '''Yell''' would be a versatile part. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-01 DX Starter, [[Valkyrie Wing Accel]], on July 18th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Valtryek and Unicrest Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Driver with a flat tip and mobility, it moves around the Beystadium in a circle at high speed and gives powerful attacks to the opponent. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Accel''' features a plastic flat tip with a small diameter and sits at the standard height. The center of the Driver also contains an embossed logo featuring a stylized letter A for easy differentiation from other Drivers. Due to the surface area, '''Accel''' will create an aggressive, and if launched at an angle, somewhat easily controllable movement pattern. In terms of speed, '''Accel''' is faster than [[Driver - Blow|Blow]] but is slower than [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]], capable of reaching and stalling on the Tornado Ridge. Due to the plastic construction, '''Accel''' is an excellent choice for both Mobile Stamina and Attack/Stamina Balance Combinations. Furthermore, the solid construction also ensures that '''Accel''' will not wear out like other Drivers such as [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] nor be damaged like [[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]. However, '''Accel''''s plastic construction is also a weakness as Attack Combinations using '''Accel''' can lose their Banking Pattern somewhat easily, especially if the Combinations are unbalanced. Furthermore, the low friction means that '''Accel''' is liable to Self-Knock-Outs. ==Use in Attack Combinations== '''Accel''' can be used in the Attack Combination [[Layer - Cho-Z Valkyrie|Cho-Z Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Cho-Z Achilles|Cho-Z Achilles]]/[[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 00|00]]/[[Disc - 10|10]]/[[Disc - 8|8]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Turn|Turn]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] '''Accel'''. The heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 00|00]]/[[Disc - 10|10]]/[[Disc - 8|8]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Turn|Turn]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] bolsters the Attack potential of [[Layer - Cho-Z Valkyrie|Cho-Z Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Cho-Z Achilles|Cho-Z Achilles]]/[[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]] while the Layer's weight, strong teeth and gimmick compensates for the Burst risk. If one struggles to control rubber Drivers at the spin speeds needed to activate [[Layer - Cho-Z Valkyrie|Cho-Z Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Cho-Z Achilles|Cho-Z Achilles]]' gimmick, then '''Accel''' can be used instead with the combination's high spin speeds compensating for the slower movement. ==Overall== Takara Tomy's '''Accel''' was once one of the best Drivers for Mobile Stamina Combinations, but due to the introduction of left-spin Beyblades in the Burst System, Mobile Stamina Combinations are no longer useful for competitive play. Hasbro's '''Accel''' is rounded, creating speeds akin to [[Driver - Blow|Blow]], struggling to reach the Tornado Ridge and settling into the center much more quickly. '''As such, Accel is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-01 [[Valkyrie Wing Accel]] (translucent blue) * B-06 [[Ragnaruk Central Accel]] (translucent dark blue) * B-08 [[Beyblade Start Dash Set (Burst)|Beyblade Start Dash Set]] - [[Valkyrie Wing Accel]] (translucent turquoise) * B-12 [[Deathscyther Oval Accel]] (translucent purple) * B-15 [[Random Booster Vol. 1 Trident Heavy Claw]] - 06: [[Spriggan Central Accel]] (translucent indigo) * B-15 [[Random Booster Vol. 1 Trident Heavy Claw]] - 08: [[Kerbeus Spread Accel]] (translucent pale pink) * B-18 [[Beyblade VS Battle Set]] - [[Valkyrie Wing Accel]] (translucent blue) * B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] - 04: [[Wyvern Heavy Accel]] (translucent blue) * B-29 [[Valkyrie Wing Accel Entry Package]] - [[Valkyrie Wing Accel]] * B-67 [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]] - 03: [[Unlock Unicorn Quarter Accel]] * B-00 [[Valkyrie Wing Accel]] (Black Knight Ver.) }}{{Translation|'''Assault'''|アサルト|Asaruto}}, stylized as '''αssault''', is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-00α Booster, [[Amaterios Aero Assault]], in August 2015.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Assault''' is a wider version of [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]. It is a flat-based Driver and is the same height as all previous Drivers released in the [[Beyblade Burst]] series. The top of the Driver features a symbol called alpha (α, the first letter of the Greek alphabet) which represents "αssault", for easy recognition between other Drivers. While Bladers commonly spell it as '''Assault''', the use of the α in the official spelling ensures that the one-part-per-letter rule gets followed in the [[Burst System]], instead of doubling the As.

'''Assault''' performs like a standard flat tip, but it is just much faster around the stadium compared to previous releases because of its tip's wider circumference. The enhanced speed makes '''Assault''' great for Attack Combinations, but this comes with sacrifices of control of the Beyblade. Due to the speed this Driver produces, it makes it a lot harder to pull off a flower pattern by [[Banking]] or performing a [[Sliding Shoot]]. As such, it is mostly only good at defeating Mobile Combinations that wander close to the Tornado Ridge, which it follows wildly once it catches onto it. The larger surface of contact's higher friction also comes at the expense of lower Stamina, with '''Assault''' losing spin velocity earlier than smaller flat tips and delivering mediocre hits by the time it reaches the center of the stadium.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Attack Combinations==
With its incredible speed, [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] '''Assault''' is able to easily Knock-Out Combinations such as [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] [[Driver - Accel|Accel]], a Mobile Defense Combination, by simply pushing it out of the stadium.

==Overall==
'''Assault''' is a genuine improvement over [[Driver - Accel|Accel]] for Attack Combinations. However, with the release of [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] which is faster with greater control, '''Assault''' has become outclassed.

'''As such, Assault is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-15 [[Random Booster Vol. 1 Trident Heavy Claw]] on September 19th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Hyper Horusood H2 Upper Claw]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Stamina Type Driver that has claws that automatically move based on rotation and help increase centrifugal force. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Claw''' features a low angled cone tip akin to [[Driver - Survive|Survive]], albeit with a smaller diameter, with four free-moving "claws" along the sides of the Tip, akin to Metal Fight Beyblade's C145 Track. When spinning, the centrifugal force will force the claws up and outwards to in theory increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and in turn increase Stamina. In practice however, such an effect is negligible and does little to increase Stamina potential. Furthermore, when spin speed drops and the claws fall back down they scrape against the stadium floor and reduce Precession time, making '''Claw''' outclassed by [[Driver - Survive|Survive]] for Stamina. However, the claws grant '''Claw''' decent Knock-Out Resistance as they will scrape against the stadium floor if a '''Claw''' Combination is struck and resist Knock-Outs at the cost of Stamina, akin to the tabs of [[Driver - Defense|Defense]]. Furthermore, the small point of contact creates low friction with the stadium floor and increases Burst Resistance. ==Overall== '''Claw''' was once a decent Driver for Defense Combinations but due to the release of [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]], [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]] and [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]], '''Claw''' has become heavily outclassed for both Stamina and Defense. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-69 Booster, [[Jail Jormungand Infinity Cycle]], on January 21st, 2017. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Jumbo Jormuntor J2 and Ferro Fengriff F2 Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Stamina Type Driver that rotates for a long time by increasing its centrifugal force with its disc that has two large blades that rotates freely. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Cycle''' features a low angle cone tip akin to [[Driver - Survive|Survive]], but differs by having a free-spinning disc above the tip, akin to Metal Fight Beyblade's Eternal Defense 145, the housing of which also extends down around the tip creating a free spinning ring like an inverse [[Driver - Gyro|Gyro]]. In practice however, the disc does little to Stabilize a Combination and causes Stamina loss despite the free spinning nature as pressure at an angle, which is created by a listing Beyblade, creates resistance and makes the disc lock up. While the secondary point of contact created by the disc can create some level of Knock-Out Resistance equal to [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]], the resistance caused by the disc locking up increases the risk of Bursts, unlike [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]] which increases Burst Resistance. ==Overall== Due to this Tip's mediocre stamina and poor Burst Resistance caused by the disc, '''Cycle''' is outclassed by other Tips such as [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]], [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]] and [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]]. B9492 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Defense |Weight= |System=Burst System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=July 18th, 2015 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=3 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=1 |SpeedStat=1 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Defense'''|ディフェンス|Difensu}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-04 Starter, [[Kerbeus Central Defense (Takara Tomy)|Kerbeus Central Defense]], on July 18th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Valtryek and Unicrest Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Driver with a circular tip, a lot of contact surfaces, a large ring, a heavy weight, and high Defensive power. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Defense''' features a ball tip and sits at a standard height. A ring sits halfway down the Driver, and the ball tip has four tabs. The tabs are intended to force the '''Defense''' Combination back into an upright position after being knocked off balance and act as brakes to prevent Knock-Outs by striking against the stadium floor at the cost of Stamina. While the ring may imply Defense potential, it is positioned too low for any opposing Beyblade to make contact with. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Spryzen and Odax Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Balance Type Driver that can change its movements from that of an Attack Type to a Stamina Type with a protrusion on the tip of its flat shaft tip. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Fusion''' features a plastic flat tip with a small diameter and a small protrusion in the center, akin to Flat Sharp from Metal Fight Beyblade, and sits at the standard height. The center of the Driver also contains an embossed logo featuring a stylized letter "F" for easy differentiation from other Drivers. When launched parallel to the stadium, '''Fusion''' will spin on the protrusion, creating a stable, Stamina-conserving spin. When knocked off balance by the opponent or launched at an angle, the flat tip will contact the stadium floor and create a movement pattern with the same speed as [[Driver - Accel|Accel]] before returning to balancing on the protrusion. However the aggressive movement is unreliable as the protrusion can slow a '''Fusion''' Combination down in the center of the stadium or stop the movement entirely. Furthermore, the small size of the protrusion means that when a '''Fusion''' Combination slows down and lists, contact will be made with the flat base, severely reducing Stamina. ==Overall== Due to the center protrusion, '''Fusion''' is inconsistent in Attack and due to the flat base, '''Fusion''' is inconsistent in Stamina as well. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-31 Starter, [[Yggdrasil Ring Gyro]], on February 20th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Caynox and Wild Wyvron W2 Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = The free rotation of its tip reduces friction with the stadium floor, making it easy to spin for a long time. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Gyro''' features a small free-spinning, low angled cone tip and is at the height of a standard Driver. In prime condition, '''Gyro''' causes the Beyblade to have a calm movement pattern while the low angle of the tip resists Destabilization and subsequent scrape risks. The free-spinning nature of '''Gyro''' allows it to outclass its predecessor [[Driver - Survive|Survive]] in Stamina potential. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== '''Gyro''' can be used in the Stamina Combination [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] '''Gyro''', with outstanding Stamina similar to [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] [[Driver - Defense|Defense]]'s. ==Use as an Attack/Stamina Hybrid== '''Gyro''' can be used in the Attack/Stamina Hybrid [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] '''Gyro''', which is designed to win against Stationary [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] Combinations by Burst, like its counterpart, [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]] [[Driver - Survive|Survive]]. It can do this consistently like [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] [[Tip - Xtreme|Xtreme]], but with less risk of Self-Knock-Outs. While '''Gyro''' is more prone to being Destabilized than Drivers such as [[Driver - Claw|Claw]] and [[Driver - Survive|Survive]], its superior Stamina makes up for this. ==Overall== '''Gyro''''s Stamina is very similar to that of [[Driver - Defense|Defense]], however, with the release of [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]] and [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]], '''Gyro''' has become severely outclassed. parts.title: Driver - Hold
parts.text:
{{About|Hold|Driver - Hold'|its Dash counterpart}} {{Part Infobox |Image=DriverHold.png |Name=Hold |JPName=ホールド |RomajiName=Hōrudo |AKA=H |HasbroCode=TA09 |ProductCode=B-63 (Takara Tomy)
C2333 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Attack |Weight=6.5 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=November 12th, 2016 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=1 |WeightStat=0 |SpeedStat=4 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Hold'''|ホールド|Hōrudo}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-63 Booster, [[Beast Behemoth Heavy Hold]], on November 12th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Beast Betromoth B2 Heavy Hold]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = An Attack Type Driver that can accelerate and rampage through the stadium, even in the latter half of the battle, with its large disk-shaped tip that rotates freely. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Hold''' features a wide free-rotating flat tip surrounded by a textured ring. Due to the wide surface area, '''Hold''' is one of the most aggressive and fastest Drivers. While this level of speed implies that a '''Hold''' Combination would launch itself out of the stadium, the friction given by the textured ring allows it to stay on the Tornado Ridge. Furthermore, the free-rotating flat tip mitigates its speed to more controllable levels and provides stability, preventing a '''Hold''' Combination from tipping over. Due to the wide shape of the tip, it is incredibly difficult to maintain a banking pattern; however, '''Hold''' can be used as a counter against Tornado Staller and Mobile Stamina Combinations as its speed can outpace most of the common Driver choices such as [[Driver - Accel'|Accel']], [[Driver - Zephyr'|Zephyr']] and [[Driver - Trans'|Trans']]. However, '''Hold''' itself cannot be used for a Tornado Staller Combination, as its Stamina is too low to be feasible. The speed of '''Hold''' can vary as some copies will rotate more freely than others: the more the tip rotates, the less speed and more Stamina it has, which makes it easier to control. Such copies of '''Hold''' will not catch on the Tornado Ridge but will instead circle around the center slowly. Once contact has been made with the opponent, the force of impact will make the textured ring contact the stadium, creating sudden bursts of acceleration. Due to these factors, '''Hold''' does not perform well in Attack Combinations and performs best in Spin-Equalization Combinations. The free-rotating nature and textured ring of '''Hold''' allows for excellent Spin-Equalization potential while also granting the Precession and Life-After-Death (LAD) needed to win such matchups. ==Use in Spin-Equalization/Attack Combinations== '''Hold''' can be put to use in the Spin-Equalization Combination [[Layer - Lost Longinus|Lost Longinus]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] '''Hold'''. [[Layer - Lost Longinus|Lost Longinus]]'s heavy weight, left-spin nature and aggressive design allows this Combination to Spin-Equalize with a right-spin opponent, resist Knock-Outs, and potentially Knock-Out or Burst the opponent. '''Hold''''s free-rotating tip gives this Combination the high levels of Precession needed for Spin-Equalization, allowing it to Out-Spin the opponent. ==Overall== Despite its high speed, '''Hold''' performs poorly in Attack Combinations due to how uncontrollable it is, but its excellent Spin-Equalization potential made it a top-tier part in such Combinations. However, it has since been outclassed by more consistent options such as [[Driver - Destroy'|Destroy']], due to '''Hold''''s inconsistency in how free-rotating it is. '''As such, Hold is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-63 [[Beast Behemoth Heavy Hold]] (translucent dark purple) * B-80 [[Random Booster Vol. 6 Tornado Wyvern.4G.At]] - 06: [[Inferno Ifrit 2Vortex Hold]] (translucent cyan) * B-00 Hold (Limited Color) ===Hasbro=== * C2333 [[Beast Betromoth B2 Heavy Hold]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DriverHold.png|Hold (B-63) SKDGC.jpg|Hold (Limited Color; B-00) ===Hasbro=== DriverHoldHasbro.png|Hold (C2333) ==Trivia== * The Limited Color Hold Driver was obtainable by purchasing up to 2000円 in Takara Tomy Beyblade Burst products from certain stores in Japan. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Xeno Xcalius X2 Magnum Impact]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Driver that can continue to attack for a long time with its jagged tip made up of rubber and plastic. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Impact''' is an Attack Type Driver that features a star shaped rubber tip with three points. The plastic of the Driver extends between these three points on the rubber tip, filling in the space. However, the two different surfaces makes '''Impact''' difficult to control and effectively reduces its Stamina, as the two different surfaces are contacting the stadium floor simultaneously, worsening the friction between the Driver and the stadium floor. The constant change in surface effectively halts the Driver: speeding up with the rubber, then slowing down with the plastic, and so forth. Because of this, '''Impact''' is not recommended for any Combination. ==Overall== Due to its attributes, '''Impact''' is not recommended for use in Attack, Defense, or Stamina Combinations, as its lack of control hinders its ability to Attack effectively, and it has too little Stamina to be a viable choice in any other Combinations.
