{{About|Liner|Driver - Liner'|its Dash counterpart|5 = Driver - Liner-S|6 = its SlingShock counterpart|8 = Driver - Liner-Q|9 = its QuadDrive counterpart}} {{Outdated}} {{Part Infobox |Image=DriverLiner.png |Name=Liner |JPName=ライナー |RomajiName=Rainā |AKA=L |HasbroCode=TB05 |ProductCode=B-64 (Takara Tomy)
C3179 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Balance |Weight=5.3 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=November 12th, 2016 |AttackStat=1 |DefenseStat=1 |StaminaStat=1 |WeightStat=0 |SpeedStat=2 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Liner'''|ライナー|Rainā}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-64 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Heavy Ver.]] on November 12th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Inferno Ifritor I2 Magnum Liner]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Balance Type Driver that changes its movement depending on the direction it had been attacked from by rotating its wheel-disc built into its tip. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Liner''' is a Driver that features a free-spinning wheel that's positioned vertically. As its name suggests, '''Liner''' features a "Stabilization" gimmick that is meant to realign the Beyblade; in this case, through the use of its free-spinning wheel. At first, depending on the parts used, '''Liner''' is mostly stationary and easily takes refuge in the center of the stadium. However, once struck by the opponent, '''Liner''''s free-spinning wheel will move, creating a somewhat erratic movement pattern, and thus, theoretically, will retake refuge in the center of the stadium. In practice, the Beyblade is easily capable of heading back into the center when struck, and thus '''Liner''''s "Stabilization" gimmick works as intended. At the same time, this gimmick also allows the Beyblade to counterattack the opponent, potentially being able to Knock-Out or Burst them. Sometimes, this even results in continuous head-on collisions. However, while this may imply Attack potential, '''Liner''' can become unbalanced, which acts as a "double-edged sword"; as the unbalanced nature, while it is beneficial in Attack Combinations, can also increase the risk of Bursts and creates poor late-game Stamina. This also makes '''Liner''' ill-suited for Spin-Equalization Combinations, as the late-game unstable spin of the tip's wheel will prevent the Combination's Layer's rubber from making direct contact with the opponent. As such, '''Liner''' is best suited for Knock-Out Defense Combinations; as the ability to quickly get from the Tornado Ridge to the center of the stadium allows it to avoid potential Knock-Outs than most other Drivers, such as [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]]. ==Overall== |-|Burst= '''As such, Liner is not recommended for the Burst Format.''' |-|Burst GT= '''As such, Liner is not recommended for the Burst GT Format.''' |-|Burst Limited= '''As such, Liner is not recommended for the Burst Limited Format.''' |-|Burst Classic= While '''Liner''' does have a working gimmick, its drawbacks limit its use for most commonly used types of Combinations, and only works best in Knock-Out Defense Combinations. While it can take back the center more quickly than [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] or [[Driver - Yard|Yard]], they are considered better options over '''Liner''' due to having better late-game Stamina, and aren't as unbalanced as '''Liner''' is near the end of a battle. As such, '''Liner''' is only effective if used against Same-Spin Attack Combinations, mainly ones that use rubber Drivers such as [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Xtreme'|Xtreme']] or [[Driver - Hunter|Hunter]]/[[Driver - Hunter'|Hunter']]; as their low Stamina makes it difficult to Knock-Out the Combination if it uses a low-recoil Layer. '''As such, Liner is not a must-have but is instead a welcome addition for the Burst Classic Format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-64 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Heavy Ver.]] - [[Inferno Ifrit Magnum Liner]] (translucent dark red) * B-80 [[Random Booster Vol. 6 Tornado Wyvern.4G.At]] - 07: [[Fang Fenrir 6Glaive Liner]] (Light Red) * B-87 [[Random Booster Vol. 7 Maximum Garuda.8F.Fl]] - 04: [[Blaze Ragnaruk Nine Liner]] (Red) * B-00 Liner (Limited Color) ===Hasbro=== * C3179 [[Inferno Ifritor I2 Magnum Liner]] * E1054 [[Beast Betromoth B2 Down Liner]] * E2458 [[Elite Warrior 4 Pack]] - [[Dranzer Spiral Spread Liner]] * E2756 [[Hyper Horusood H2 Quarter Liner]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DriverLiner.png|Liner (B-64) Limited Driver Campaign.jpg|Liner (Limited Color; B-00) ===Hasbro=== ==Trivia== * The Limited Color Liner Driver was obtainable by purchasing up to 2000円 in Takara Tomy Beyblade Burst products from certain stores in Japan. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-14 Starter, [[Wyvern Armed Massive]], on September 19th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Single Pack, [[Wyvron Armed Massive]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Defense Type Driver that grips the stadium floor with its large hemispheric tip and its outer claws. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Massive''' features a ball shaped tip that sits at the standard height, akin to [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]], but differs by having a larger diameter, having three tabs instead of four and lacking the defensive ring. In theory, the wider tip would increase a Beyblade's Defense by having greater surface area and friction, however in practice, '''Massive''' lags behind [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]] in almost every aspect. Like other ball based Defense Drivers, the tabs around '''Massive''' are meant to act as brakes against Knock-Outs at the cost of Stamina by striking against the stadium floor, however, the larger diameter makes such contact rare, giving '''Massive''' weaker Knock-Out Resistance than [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]]. The greater surface area of the larger ball creates a semi-aggressive movement pattern early in the battle, bringing a Beyblade closer to the Tornado Ridge. Due to the aforementioned weaker Knock-Out Resistance, any Beyblade using this tip will become very easy to Knock-Out. While '''Massive''' lacks the scrape risk the ring around [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]] posed, it does little to compensate for the fact that '''Massive''''s greater surface area and friction gives it weaker Stamina than [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]]. ==Overall== While similar to Metal Fight Beyblade's Wide Ball, '''Massive''' ultimately lags behind [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]] in every category, having weaker Stamina and weaker Knock-Out Resistance. C0598 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Defense |Weight= |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=December 26th, 2015 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=4 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=0 |SpeedStat=1 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Needle'''|ニードル|Nīdoru}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] on December 26th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Dark Doomscizor D2 and Uber Unicrest U2 Dual Pack|Dark Doomscizor D2 and Über Unicrest U2 Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Defense Type Driver that stays up when it is repelled, which has a tip with multiple fine bumps. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Needle''' features a ball shaped tip at standard height covered with small studs and has four small tabs surrounding the center of the tip like [[Driver - Defense|Defense]]. The studded design is meant to increase friction with the stadium floor and the small tabs are meant to act as brakes by striking against the stadium floor, both to prevent Knock-Outs. When in mint condition and launched with significant power, '''Needle''' moves around the stadium akin to an Attack Type for a short period of time before it moves and settles to the center of the stadium, like the Jog Ball Driver from Metal Fight Beyblade. When the tip settles in the center of the stadium it will spin on very few of the studs and conserve Stamina, acting similarly to the stud of [[Driver - Fusion|Fusion]]. When struck by an opposing Beyblade, more studs and the four tabs will come into contact with the curvature of the stadium floor, increasing friction and Knock-Out Defense at the cost of Stamina loss. When worn however, the studs of the tip flatten down and create a smooth surface, creating a performance akin to [[Driver - Defense|Defense]] with greater Stamina and less initial roaming. Depending on the launch strength, the initial movement can be used to avoid attacks from Beyblades in a banking pattern or it can bring the Beyblade too close to the edge and be vulnerable to Knock-Outs. ==Use in Stationary Attack Combinations== '''Needle''' can be put to use in the Stationary Attack Combination [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 1|1]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]] '''Needle'''. The initial movement of '''Needle''' improves Attack potential while the Knock-Out Resistance of '''Needle''''s studs and tabs and the heavy weight of the [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 1|1]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] Disc can resist Self-Knock-Outs from [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]]'s recoil. ==Overall== While '''Needle''' is outclassed by other Tips such as [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]], it exhibits various properties like its ability to Attack or evade with its initial movement, defend against Knock-Outs and conserve Stamina when against a passive opponent. '''As such, Needle is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] - 01: [[Evil-eye Wing Needle]] (translucent green) * B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] - 05: [[Wyvern Central Needle]] (translucent blue green) * B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] - 08: [[Valkyrie Oval Needle]] (translucent turquoise) * B-56 [[Unlock Unicorn Down Needle]] * B-67 [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]] - 02: [[Nova Neptune Quarter Needle]] * B-00 Needle (Red Ver.) E1057 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Defense |Weight=6.14 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=April 29th, 2016 |ReleaseUS=November 2017 |ReleaseCA=November 2017 |AttackStat=0 |DefenseStat=3 |StaminaStat=2 |WeightStat=0 |SpeedStat=0 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Orbit'''|オービット|Ōbitto}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-41 Starter, [[Wild Wyvern Vertical Orbit]], on April 29th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Atlas Anubion A2 Yell Orbit]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Defense Type Driver that can parry attacks from any direction by rotating a small ball equipped at its tip. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Orbit''' features a free rotating plastic ball tip with a diameter equal to [[Driver - Massive|Massive]], surrounded by a three tabbed ring. In theory, the wider tip would increase a Beyblade's Knock-Out Defense by having greater surface area and friction, however, in practice the free rotating nature of the ball reduces most of the Knock-Out Resistance given by the surface area of the ball. Like other ball based Defense Drivers, the tabs around '''Orbit''' are meant to act as brakes against Knock-Outs at the cost of Stamina by striking against the stadium floor, however, the large diameter makes such contact rare. If hard launched, '''Orbit''' creates an aggressive movement pattern early in the battle, bringing the Beyblade to the Tornado Ridge. While these features may imply that '''Orbit'''-based Combinations would be easy to Knock-Out, in reality the heavy weight of SwitchStrike/God Layers and Core Discs compensate for the rotating ball. Furthermore, the free rotating tip increases the Burst Resistance of an '''Orbit'''-based Combination and '''Orbit''' consistently has a stronger spring lock than [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] which further improves Burst Resistance. In addition to the Defense properties, '''Orbit''' also features high Stamina as the free rotating nature reduces friction with the stadium floor, the wide ball tip keeps a Combination stable and thus prevents scraping. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== '''Orbit''' can be put to use in the Stamina Combination (A Mold God Chip) [[Layer - Deep Chaos|Deep Chaos]]/[[Layer - Screw Trident|Screw Trident]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]] '''Orbit'''. The heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] adds Knock-Out Resistance to and bolsters the Stamina of the Combination. The low friction of '''Orbit''' further bolsters the Stamina of the [[Layer - Deep Chaos|Deep Chaos]]/[[Layer - Screw Trident|Screw Trident]] Layer and [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] and adds the Burst Resistance to the Combination while [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]] adds Life-After-Death. These factors allow the Combination to resist Knock-Outs and Bursts and Out-Spin the opponent. ==Use in Balance Combinations== '''Orbit''' can be put to use in the Balance Combination ([[Metal God Chip]]) [[Layer - Galaxy Zeus|Galaxy Zeus]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]] '''Orbit'''. The free-spinning ball of '''Orbit''' bolsters the Stamina and Burst Resistance of the Layer, the heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] further bolsters Stamina and aids in Knock-Out Resistance while the other parts can compensate for the Burst risk of using heavy Discs and [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]] adds Life-After-Death, giving the Combination greater chances of Out-Spinning the opponent. This Combination is capable of Out-Spinning Attack and Defense Combinations with its Stamina and Burst/Knock-Out Resistance and can potentially Burst Combinations with its recoil inducing square shape. ==Use in Stationary Attack Combinations== '''Orbit''' can be put to use in the Stationary Burst Attack Combination [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]]/[[Layer - Twin Nemesis|Twin Nemesis]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]]/[[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] '''Orbit'''. The aggressive shape of [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]]/[[Layer - Twin Nemesis|Twin Nemesis]] combined with the heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]]/[[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] and the semi-aggressive movement provided by '''Orbit''', can provide powerful hits to Burst the opponent. The low friction of '''Orbit''' also reduces chances of Self-Bursting. ==Overall== '''Orbit''' features high Stamina and Burst Defense properties making it one of the best Drivers available for Defense and Stamina Combinations. While [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] may have comparable performance with greater Life-After-Death, '''Orbit''' has greater Burst Resistance. '''As such, if one cannot obtain Atomic, then Orbit is a must have for competitive bladers. However, if one does have Atomic, Orbit is a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' ==Differences in the Hasbro Version== Hasbro's '''Orb

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-21 [[Beyblade Custom Set Attack & Balance]] on November 14th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Custom Clash Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = An Attack Type Driver that specializes in rampaging around the stadium due to the shape of its axis that is displaced from its center. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Quake''' features an elliptical shaped flat tip that is off center of the Driver, meant to make the Beyblade that it is connected to jump around the stadium akin to Quake in Metal Fight Beyblade. However, due to how shallow the tip's angle is as well as how little it is off center, the effect is not consistent and must rely on a lightweight and off balance Combination as well as a heavily angled launch. The hopping gimmick is meant to create Disc-to-Layer contact and Burst the opponent, however the aforementioned lack of consistency in the effect makes such an attack method not recommended for competitive play. Furthermore, the offset and slanted tip means that '''Quake''' is incapable of maintaining a Banking Pattern and will grind against the Tornado Ridge, making '''Quake''' ill-suited for Mobile Attack and Tornado Staller Combinations in general. ==Overall== '''Quake''' features poor Stamina, poor control and inconsistent Hop Attack potential. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-36 Booster, [[Rising Ragnaruk Gravity Revolve]], on April 2nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Raging Roktavor R2 Gravity Revolve]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Stamina Type Driver that does not lose its rotational speed, even at the end of the battle, due to its free-spinning guard disc attached around its sharp tip. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Revolve''' features a sharp tip of a small diameter surrounded by a free spinning ring. The sharp tip of '''Revolve''' provides low friction with the stadium floor, resulting in high Stamina and Burst Defense properties. While the small diameter of the sharp tip may imply easy Destabilization, the wide diameter of the free spinning ring helps maintain Stability. The wide diameter of the ring also provides '''Revolve''' high Precession time which is useful against Opposite-Spin and Mobile Stamina Combinations. Furthermore, when launched at an angle, the free spinning ring of '''Revolve''' makes more contact with the stadium floor resulting in decent Knock-Out Resistance, however said Knock-Out Resistance still lags behind that of [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]] and [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] due to the lower surface area and some Beyblades that are off center are easier to Burst. Hasbro later reprinted Takara Tomy's B-36 release in the [[Pro Series]] [[Heaven Pegasus 10Proof Low Sen]] Starter Pack, albeit with weaker plastic. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== '''Revolve''' can be put to use in the Stamina Combination (A Mold God Chip) [[Layer - Deep Chaos|Deep Chaos]]/[[Layer - Screw Trident|Screw Trident]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Cross|Cross]] '''Revolve'''. The high Stamina of [[Layer - Deep Chaos|Deep Chaos]]/[[Layer - Screw Trident|Screw Trident]] is further bolstered by [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Cross|Cross]] and the poor Burst Resistance of the Layer is bolstered by the low friction of '''Revolve''' and its strong spring lock. This Combination is capable of Out-Spinning almost all Same-Spin Combinations but is highly vulnerable to Attack Combinations. ==Overall== Takara Tomy's '''Revolve''' features high Stamina and Burst Defense properties making it one of the best choices for Pure Stamina Combinations and Stationary Attack Combinations, capable of Out-Spinning Same-Spin [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] Combinations. However, with the release of [[Driver - Bearing|Bearing]] and [[Driver - Eternal|Eternal]] which can defeat Opposite-Spin [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] Combinations, '''Revolve''' has become outclassed. '''As such, Takara Tomy's Revolve is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' == Differences in the Hasbro Version == Hasbro's '''Revolve''' has a weak spring lock akin to Takara Tomy's [[Driver - Bearing|Bearing]], causing it to provide a weaker fit compared to other Drivers such as [[Driver - Survive|Survive]]. Furthermore, Hasbro's [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] and [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]] have stronger spring locks with comparable Stamina. '''As such, Hasbro's Revolve is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-36 [[Rising Ragnaruk Gravity Revolve]] * B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] - 04: [[Kaiser Kerbeus Knuckle Revolve]] * B-90 [[3on3 Battle Booster Set]] - [[Guardian Kerbeus Heavy Revolve]] * B-95 [[Random Booster Vol. 8 Shelter Regulus.5S.Tw]] - 04: [[Blaze Ragnaruk Triple Revolve]] * B-151 [[Random Booster Vol. 17]] - 03: [[Tact Fafnir 11 Revolve Sen]] * B-153 [[Gatinko Customize Set]] - [[Cosmo Dragon Vanguard Revolve Retsu]] * B-156 [[Random Booster Vol. 18]] - 03: [[Dread Fafnir Paradox Revolve Metsu]] * B-161 [[Glide Ragnaruk Wheel Revolve 1S]] * B-170 [[Random Booster Vol. 21]] - 05: [[Air Knight 10 Revolve]] * B-186 [[Random Booster Vol. 26]] - 02: [[Roar Fafnir 00 Revolve-2]] * B-00 Revolve (Platinum Ver.) It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-66 Starter, [[Lost Longinus Nine Spiral]], on December 28th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Lost Luinor L2 Nine Spiral|Lost Lúinor L2 Nine Spiral]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Spiral's tip has spikes protruding in a spiral shape that strongly grip the stadium when spinning counterclockwise. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Spiral''' is a flat tip with spikes protruding outwards and pointing to the left. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-03 Starter, [[Ragnaruk Heavy Survive]], on July 18th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Roktavor and Nepstrius Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Driver with high endurance that reduces friction with the Beystadium due to the sharp shape of its tip. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Survive''' is a Performace Tip with a low-angled cone shape protruding from a cylinder. As a result, while it is overpowered by some [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]] Combinations, it has still shown to be useful in Stamina-based Burst Combinations. However, it can also be used as a Defense Driver in absence of better ones, and while it is outclassed, its shape helps it rebound from attacks and prevent Knock-Outs. While good ball-shaped or rubber sharp Drivers lack in Beyblade Burst, '''Survive''' has enough Stability to take hits without losing all balance and Precessing too early like sharper tips. ==Use in Stamina Combinations== '''Survive''' is an important part of the Stamina Combination [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] '''Survive'''. [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] '''Survive''' has placed in many tournaments due to [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]]'s smooth and round shape coupling with [[Disc - Spread|Spread]]'s weight distribution and '''Survive''''s Stamina and ability to Out-Spin many other Combinations. However, in the absence of these parts, other, less viable Stamina parts have been used with '''Survive''' to produce a similar effect. Some examples of this are [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] '''Survive''' and [[Layer - Odin|Odin]] [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] '''Survive'''. ==Use in Attack/Stamina Hybrids== '''Survive''' plays a vital role in the Attack/Stamina Hybrid [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] '''Survive'''. Though it became a risky choice in tournaments with the release of [[Layer - Odin|Odin]], it can be used effectively for beating the Combination [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] [[Disc - Spread|Spread]] '''Survive''' and solely for that reason. ==Overall== With a low angle and fairly wide diameter, '''Survive''' was once a top-tier part for Stamina Combinations. However, it has since been heavily outclassed by [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]] and [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] due to its lack of free spinning components. {{About|Trans|Driver - Trans'|its Dash counterpart}} {{Part Infobox |Image=DriverTrans.png |Name=Trans |JPName=トランス |RomajiName=Toransu |AKA=T |HasbroCode=TB04 |ProductCode=B-57 (Takara Tomy)
E1032 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Balance |Weight=6.5 grams |System=Dual Layer System |System2=SwitchStrike System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=August 6th, 2016 |AttackStat=2 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=1 |SpeedStat=2 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Trans'''|トランス|Toransu}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[SwitchStrike System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-57 [[Triple Booster Set]] on August 6th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s SwitchStrike Starter Pack, [[Alter Cognite C3 6Meteor Trans]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Balance Type Driver that can be switched between its Attack and Stamina modes. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Trans''' features an adjustable tip at standard height with two settings, Stamina and Attack, which are switched by twisting the bottom portion of the Driver. Embossed onto the top is a stylized "T" for easy differentiation. The Stamina setting exposes a small low angle cone tip meant to make the Beyblade stationary in the center of the stadium, however to accommodate the mode change the cone tip is incredibly small in diameter, unlike [[Driver - Survive|Survive]]. Due to this, the tip is susceptible to being knocked off balance in this setting and with the bulky size of '''Trans''', can lead to risks of scraping, though this effect is mitigated by the low angle of the tip. However, the setting lags behind Tips such as [[Driver - Eternal|Eternal]] to due to the lack of a free spinning component. The Attack setting covers the cone tip with a flat tip with a hole in the center akin to [[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]], creating an aggressive but controllable movement pattern with a hybrid of Attack and Stamina properties, ideal for Mobile Stamina Combinations. However the edges of the flat tip has 4 small tabs around it which prevents the tip from catching onto the Tornado Ridge, instead causing it to grind and lose Stamina making this tip a poor choice for Tornado Stalling Combinations. ==Use in Attack Combinations== '''Trans''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 1|1]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]] '''Trans'''. The high recoil of the Layer is enhanced by the heavy weight of the [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 1|1]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] Disc while the heavy weight also bolsters Knock-Out Resistance. The use of '''Trans''' can make the Combination a Mobile or Stationary Attack Combination while the plastic construction bolsters the Stamina of the Disc and Frame. ==Use in Attack/Stamina Combinations== '''Trans''' can be put to use in the Balance Combination [[Layer - Twin Nemesis|Twin Nemesis]] (Upper Mode) [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]] '''Trans'''. The Destabilization potential along with the high Stamina potential of the Layer, Disc, Frame and '''Trans''' can allow the Combination to Out-Spin its opponent while also granting higher Burst Attack potential on the Attack Setting due to the movement speed. ==Overall== '''Trans''' has since been outclassed in Stamina potential by other Drivers such as [[Driver - Bearing'|Bearing']] and [[Driver - Drift|Drift]]. '''As such, Trans recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-57 [[Triple Booster Set]] - [[Nova Neptune Vertical Trans]] (translucent orange) * B-67 [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]] - [[Unlock Unicorn Upper Trans]] * B-82 [[Alter Chronos 6Meteor Trans]] * B-178 [[Random Booster Vol. 24]] - 03: [[Glide Ragnaruk 5 Trans 1S]] (Black Ver.) * B-00 [[Dranzer Spiral Spread Trans]] (blue) * B-00 [[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade 20th Anniversary Set]] - [[Dranzer Spiral Spread Trans]] ===Hasbro=== * E1032 [[Alter Cognite C3 6Meteor Trans]] * E2459 [[Spin Shifter Pack]] - [[Tempest Wyvron W3 2Glaive Trans]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DriverTrans.png|Trans (B-57) ===Hasbro=== ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} {{SwitchStrike System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-35 Starter, [[Storm Spriggan Knuckle Unite]], on April 2nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Balance Type Driver that can change freely from Attack Type-based movements to Stamina Type-based movements based on its sharp tip and the shape of the rubber surrounding it. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Unite''' features a flat rubber tip with a sharp plastic tip in the center that sits at the standard height. When launched straight down into the stadium, the sharp tip in the center will keep the Beyblade stable and still in the center, preventing Stamina loss. When a mint condition '''Unite''' is either knocked off balance by an opponent or launched at an angle, the rubber will make contact with the stadium, creating an aggressive movement pattern with speeds similar to [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]. However this aggressive movement is somewhat unreliable as the sharp center can slow it down in the center of the stadium or stop the movement entirely. When worn however, instead of creating aggressive movement when struck, the rubber will instead act as brakes against a Knock-Out, at the cost of Stamina, before going back to the center of the Stadium due to the sharp tip. ==Overall== '''Unite''''s inconsistent movements when used for Attack and poor Stamina when used for Defense prevents this tip from being top-tier. However, it is still a versatile Driver, even being able to hold its own against [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]-based Attack Combinations. B9487 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Attack |Weight=6.2 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=April 2nd, 2016 |AttackStat=2 |DefenseStat=1 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=0 |SpeedStat=3 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Variable'''|ヴァリアブル|Variaburu}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-34 Starter, [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]], on April 2nd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Equipped with a rubber tip that can change its movement depending on the angle of the launch, Variable is an Attack Type Driver that can get a strong grip onto the stadium floor to unleash high-speed attacks. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Variable''' features a rubber tip, made up of two sets of rubber spikes, that begins at standard height. The spikes are meant to wear down and break off with use so unlike most other rubber tips, '''Variable''' will become more aggressive instead of less aggressive over time. When launched in mint condition the first set of six spikes will create a mildly aggressive pattern at speeds akin to [[Driver - Blow|Blow]], albeit without the Stamina due to the greater friction the rubber has. Due to how tall the first six teeth are and the somewhat brittle nature of the rubber in the Takara Tomy release, the first set of teeth will break off relatively quickly. When launched after the first set of teeth have given way to the second set of fourteen spikes, '''Variable''''s speed increases remarkably, becoming as fast or even faster than [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]], due to the now increased surface area and diameter. However, that same speed and diameter increase makes '''Variable''' incredibly difficult to control at this stage as banking is difficult to maintain, Self-Knock-Outs become common and its Stamina worsens. Due to the greater number of spikes and their shorter length, '''Variable''' does not wear out as quickly at this stage. Of the stages, this stage of '''Variable''' is considered the best. When the second set of spikes break off, what's left is a solid base of rubber. At this point '''Variable''''s speed increases further but the aforementioned control and Stamina issues become even worse, having trouble even staying on the Tornado Ridge of the stadium and losing spin too quickly to perform any meaningful attacks when it begins to slow down. When this tip loses teeth, it does become shorter as a result, granting Attack combinations Destabilization potential. Furthermore, due to the wide base, '''Variable''' has relatively high Life-After-Death when worn down, making it a somewhat safer choice against Spin-Equalization combinations. ==Use in Attack Combinations== '''Variable''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination [[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]][[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] '''Variable''' (Worn). The high speed of '''Variable''' increases the Burst Attack potential of the [[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]][[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]] Layer's recoil and the [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] Disc and Frame's weight. However, this Combination is hard to control due to the worn '''Variable''''s speed and wide diameter. ==Overall== Despite being one of the fastest tips in the game, Takara Tomy's '''Variable''''s lack of control and Stamina makes it outclassed in most cases by [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]; which is able to better maintain a banking pattern while holding comparable speed, [[Driver - Hold|Hold]]; which is better able to stay within the Tornado Ridge and avoid Self-Knock-Outs while holding comparable speed, and [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]; which has far more control and Stamina. However, Attack combinations that do not necessarily need control can make great use of Variable's high speed and strong Attack potential, as well as its Destabilization potential given by the lower height, and the Life-After-Death potential when worn. In addition, Variable's high speed finds uses against other Attack combinations utilizing Xtreme. '''As such, Takara Tomy's Variable is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' ==Differences in the Hasbro Version== Hasbro's '''Variable''' has a much softer rubber, this makes this version faster on the first six spikes, having a speed in between [[Driver - Accel|Accel]] and [[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]], and makes it far harder to wear down. However that also means that when it does wear down to the second set of teeth the control problems will be even worse than Takara Tomy's '''Variable'''. Despite the softer rubber however, an unworn Hasbro '''Variable''' settles to the center far too quickly for effective Attack Combinations. '''This along with the aforementioned control loss from wear means that Hasbro's Variable is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-34 [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] (translucent light blue, black rubber) * B-38 [[Beyblade Burst Entry Set]] - [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]] * B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] - 06: [[Storm Spriggan Limited Variable]]  * B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] - 08: [[Kaiser

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-59 Starter, [[Zillion Zeus Infinity Weight]], on September 17th, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Zillion Zeutron Z2 Infinity Weight]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Weight has a metal ball as its tip that achieves both heavy weight and friction reduction that makes it difficult to be swung. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Weight''' features a ball shaped tip made of metal, akin to Metal Fight Beyblade's Metal Ball Driver, surrounded by a plastic ridge. Like Metal Ball, the metal tip is meant to decrease friction with the stadium floor and improve Stability and Knock-Out Resistance by lowering the center of balance with its weight and the plastic ridge is meant to provide Life-After-Death with its smooth perimeter. In practice however, the shape and diameter of the ball creates a semi-aggressive movement pattern early in battle if hard launched, bringing the Beyblade close to the Tornado Ridge. Due to the low friction of the metal, a Beyblade in this state becomes much easier to Knock-Out. A secondary weakness is the plastic ridge, its low positioning means that it is easy for it to contact the stadium floor which exacerbates the aforementioned issue and drains Stamina. While '''Weight''''s sheer weight can improve Knock-Out Defense, it's mitigated by the low friction of metal and rarity of Knock-Outs in the Burst metagame. ==Overall== While the metal does give this Driver less friction and therefore more Stamina in theory, in practice its movement pattern and poor Stability makes it outclassed by other Drivers such as [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]], [[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] and [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]. Although, '''Weight''' can still act as a somewhat suitable replacement due to its high weight. '''As such, Weight is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-59 [[Zillion Zeus Infinity Weight]] (translucent yellow orange) * B-65 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Speed Ver.]] - [[Psychic Phantom Polish Weight]] (translucent yellow) * B-80 [[Random Booster Vol. 6 Tornado Wyvern.4G.At]] - 04: [[Exceed Evil-eye 2Glaive Weight]] (translucent orange) * B-80 [[Random Booster Vol. 6 Tornado Wyvern.4G.At]] - 08: [[Beast Behemoth 4Cross Weight]] (translucent brown) * B-00 [[Zillion Zeus Infinity Weight]] (Saint Thunder Ver.) * B-00 [[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade 2020 V Set]] - [[Driger Vulcan 10Reach Weight]] ===Hasbro=== * C3182 [[Zillion Zeutron Z2 Infinity Weight]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== DriverWeight.png|Weight (B-59) Weight (Saint Thunder Ver).png|Weight (Saint Thunder Ver.; B-00) ===Hasbro=== ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

{{About|Xtreme|Driver - Xtreme'|its Dash counterpart|5 = Driver - Metal Xtreme|6 = its Metal Lock counterpart}} {{Part Infobox |Image=DriverXtreme.png |Name=Xtreme |JPName=エクストリーム |RomajiName=Ekusutorīmu |AKA=X |HasbroCode=TA05 |ProductCode=B-23 (Takara Tomy)
C0596 (Hasbro) |Classification=Driver |Type=Attack |Weight=5.2 grams |System=Burst System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseJP=December 26th, 2015 |ReleaseUS=February 2017 |AttackStat=2 |DefenseStat=0 |StaminaStat=0 |WeightStat=0 |SpeedStat=4 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Xtreme'''|エクストリーム|Ekusutorīmu}} is a [[Driver]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-23 Starter, [[Xcalibur Force Xtreme]], on December 26th, 2015. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Raging Roktavor R2 and Xcalius Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = An Attack Type Driver that moves around the stadium extremely violently with its strong rubber tip grip. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Xtreme''' features a flat rubber tip with a circular depression in the center that sits at the standard height. Embossed on the top is a stylized "X" for easy differentiation. Due to the surface area to friction ratio, '''Xtreme''' will create a highly aggressive, and if launched with a Banking Shoot, somewhat controllable movement pattern. In terms of speed, '''Xtreme''' is faster than [[Driver - Accel|Accel]], [[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] and [[Driver - Assault|Assault]] but is as fast as or slower than [[Driver - Hold|Hold]] or a worn [[Driver - Variable|Variable]]. '''Xtreme''''s high speed allows for strong attacks and its high friction creates less chances of losing the Banking Pattern in battle making it one of the most common choices for Attack Combinations. However, '''Xtreme''' has three major weaknesses. Firstly, the high friction of the rubber means that '''Xtreme''' has incredibly low Stamina, furthermore, the light weight of the Burst System compared to previous Systems means that there is less inertia, exacerbating the Stamina issue further. Secondly, the high friction also means that '''Xtreme''' resists changes to the Beyblade's spin from contact with the opponent, thus more force is transferred the teeth in Takara Tomy Layers or the slopes in Hasbro Layers, increasing the chances of Self-Bursts. Lastly, '''Xtreme''' will wear down with use, decreasing its aggression with little to no improvement to the tip's Stamina, meaning that multiple copies much be purchased in order to replace worn ones. ==Use in Attack Combinations== '''Xtreme''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]]/[[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Z Achilles|Z Achilles]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]]/[[Disc - 10|10]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] '''Xtreme'''. '''Xtreme''''s high speed and friction aids the Burst Attack potential of [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]]/[[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Z Achilles|Z Achilles]], while resisting banking pattern loss from [[Layer - Sieg Xcalibur|Sieg Xcalibur]]'s unbalanced nature, the heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]]/[[Disc - 10|10]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] further adds Burst Attack and the strong teeth and heavy weight of the Layer can compensate for the Burst risk of '''Xtreme''''s friction. ==Overall== '''Xtreme''' is one of the fastest and most aggressive tips in the game, but it is plagued by low Stamina and risk of Self-Bursting. Other Drivers are able to compare to or match '''Xtreme''''s best traits while also improving on its weakness; such as [[Driver - Accel|Accel]] having greater Stamina while also being easy to control and [[Driver - Hold|Hold]] having comparable or greater speed while having greater versatility with Left-Spin Layers. However, Attack Combinations in the current metagame that utilize [[Ring - Rage|Rage]] and [[Chassis - 3A|3A]] are heavily reliant on high speed. '''With greater control over other high speed tips such as a worn Variable or Hold, competitive bladers must own several copies of Xtreme.''' == Differences in the Hasbro Version == Hasbro's '''Xtreme''' generally features softer rubber than the Takara Tomy version, which further increases aggression and speed. While this also means lower Stamina and control, such drawbacks are negligible for '''Xtreme'''-based Attack Combinations. The gold C1516 Master Kit mold and yellow C2281 mold features the softest rubber. This is followed by the white E2545 release, then the remaining red and blue releases. '''As such, Hasbro's Xtreme is a must have for competitive bladers of the Hasbro-Only Format.''' == Use in Attack Combinations == Hasbro's '''Xtreme''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination [[Layer - Legend Spryzen S3|Legend Spryzen S3]]/[[Layer - Surge Xcalius X3|Surge Xcalius X3]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] '''Xtreme'''. '''Xtreme''''s high speed and friction aids the Burst Attack potential of [[Layer - Legend Spryzen S3|Legend Spryzen S3]]/[[Layer - Surge Xcalius X3|Surge Xcalius X3]], while resisting banking pattern loss from [[Layer - Surge Xcalius X3|Surge Xcalius X3]]' unbalanced nature, and the heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] further adds Burst Attack. ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-23 [[Xcalibur Force Xtreme]] (translucent blue, red rubber) * B-46 [[Obelisk Odin Triple Xtreme]] (translucent dark blue, yellow rubber) * B-00 [[Xcalibur Force Xtreme

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-49 [[Random Booster Vol. 3 Yaeger Yggdrasil.G.Y]] on July 16th, 2016. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Yielding has a tip made of a smooth POM material that reduces friction and helps it continue to spin endlessly. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Yielding''' features a cone shaped tip made of '''P'''oly'''O'''xy'''M'''ethylene (POM) thermoplastic rather than traditional plastic. '''Yielding''''s gimmick is that the POM plastic has less friction against the stadium floor than traditional plastic, increasing a Combination's Stamina. Embossed into the top of the Driver is a stylized 'Y' for easy identification. Due to the lowered friction, '''Yielding''' yields high amounts of Stamina and procession time, however this low friction also brings lowered Knock-Out Resistance and Stability. The Stability issue is further exacerbated by the angle of the cone; unlike Metal Fight Beyblade's Defense Tip, the angle of '''Yielding''' is more acute, akin to Big Wide Defense, causing an increase in the risk of floor scrapes. It is possible to improve the Stability somewhat by wearing down the tip, however the low friction means that this takes time. The advantage '''Yielding''' has over other Drivers such as [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]] and [[Driver - Defense (Burst)|Defense]] is greater Burst Resistance as the low friction means that there is less force to be taken by the teeth of a Layer. ==Overall== Due to '''Yielding''''s high Stamina and Burst Resistance, it can be used to great effect in many Stamina and Balance Combinations. However, due to [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]] outclassing '''Yielding''' in Stamina and the Stability issues present in '''Yielding''', this part is not a must have. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-28 Booster, [[Neptune Armed Zephyr]], on January 23rd, 2016. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Roktavor and Nepstrius Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A Balance Type Driver that has both mobility and endurance with a hole in its tip to reduce friction with the stadium floor. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Zephyr''' features a hollow plastic flat tip with a small diameter, akin to Hole Flat from Metal Fight Beyblade, and sits at the standard height. Compared to [[Driver - Accel|Accel]], the diameter of '''Zephyr''' is slightly larger. The center of the Driver also contains an embossed logo featuring a stylized letter "Z" for easy differentiation from other Drivers. Due to the surface area, '''Zephyr''' will create an aggressive, and if launched at an angle, somewhat easily controllable movement pattern. In terms of speed, '''Zephyr''' is comparable to [[Driver - Accel|Accel]], capable of reaching and stalling on the Tornado Ridge. Due to the plastic construction, '''Zephyr''' is an excellent choice for both Mobile Stamina and Attack/Stamina Balance Combinations. However, '''Zephyr''''s plastic construction is also a weakness as Attack Combinations using '''Zephyr''' can lose their Banking Pattern somewhat easily, especially if the Combinations are unbalanced. Furthermore, the low friction means that '''Zephyr''' is liable to Self-Knock-Outs. Finally, due to '''Zephyr''''s hollow construction, the Driver is liable to denting in the case of Disc-to-Driver contact after a Burst. ==Use in Attack Combinations== '''Zephyr''' can be used in the Attack Combination [[Layer - Cho-Z Valkyrie|Cho-Z Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Cho-Z Achilles|Cho-Z Achilles]]/[[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]] [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 00|00]]/[[Disc - 10|10]]/[[Disc - 8|8]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Turn|Turn]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] '''Zephyr'''. The heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 00|00]]/[[Disc - 10|10]]/[[Disc - 8|8]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Turn|Turn]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] bolsters the Attack potential of [[Layer - Cho-Z Valkyrie|Cho-Z Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Cho-Z Achilles|Cho-Z Achilles]]/[[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]] while the Layer's weight, strong teeth and gimmick compensates for the Burst risk. If one struggles to control rubber Drivers at the spin speeds needed to activate [[Layer - Cho-Z Valkyrie|Cho-Z Valkyrie]]/[[Layer - Cho-Z Achilles|Cho-Z Achilles]]' gimmick, then '''Zephyr''' can be used instead with the combination's high spin speeds compensating for the slower movement. ==Overall== '''Zephyr''' is a viable Driver if one struggles to control rubber Drivers such as [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]], [[Driver - Hunter|Hunter]], and [[Driver - Jolt|Jolt]]. However, due to the dangers of the Driver denting, it is recommended to be prepared to replace it or instead use [[Driver - Zephyr'|Zephyr']]. parts.title: Burst System
parts.text:
The '''Burst System''' is the Beyblade system released as part of the ''[[Beyblade Burst]]'' toyline. All Beyblade Burst products currently released belong to this system. As the name implies, the Burst System includes a gimmick where a Beyblade can "burst" into individual parts during a battle, adding an extra way to achieve victory.

The Burst System also has several subsystems, the first two being functionally similar between Takara Tomy and Hasbro releases:
* The '''[[List of Burst System parts|Dual Layer System]]''', which focuses on Beyblades with [[Layer]]s that have been split into two layers.
* The '''[[List of God Layer System parts|God Layer System]]/[[List of SwitchStrike System parts|SwitchStrike System]]''', which incorporates gimmicks into each Beyblade.

Takara Tomy subsequently released the following four subsystems:
* The '''[[List of Cho-Z Layer System parts|Cho-Z Layer System]]''', which incorporates metal in the [[Layer]]s.
* The '''[[List of Gatinko Layer System parts|Gatinko Layer System]]''', which introduces Beyblades whose [[Layer]]s are made up of three interchangeable parts.
* The '''[[List of Superking Layer System parts|Superking Layer System]]''', which introduces Beyblades whose [[Layer]]s are made up of three interchangeable parts, as well as introducing Double [[Chassis]], which can replace Discs.
* The '''[[List of Dynamite Battle Layer System parts|Dynamite Battle Layer System]]''', which introduces Beyblades whose [[Layer]]s are made up of three interchangeable parts, as well as introducing two modes for the Layers, "High Mode" and "Low Mode".
* The '''[[List of Dynamite Battle Layer System parts|Burst Ultimate Layer Series]]''', which introduces the "BU Blade", a new version of Blades that feature gimmicks.

In addition to these, there are four Hasbro exclusive subsystems that replace the aforementioned Cho-Z, Gatinko, Superking, and Dynamite Battle Layer Systems:
* The '''[[List of SlingShock System parts|SlingShock System]]''', which focuses on lightweight Layers and Discs, and a mode-changing gimmick to the [[Drivers]] that allows the Beyblades to move at high speeds along a "Rail System".
* The '''[[List of HyperSphere System parts|HyperSphere System]]''', which is based off of the Gatinko Layer System, which focuses on bulky Drivers that allow the Beyblades to "climb" and drop down from the Vertical Wall and Brink of a HyperSphere Beystadium to counterattack the opponent at high speeds.
* The '''[[List of SpeedStorm System parts|SpeedStorm System]]''', which is based on the Superking Layer System, and uses tall Drivers to utilize "Power Vortex" zones of a SpeedStorm Beystadium to gain a "speed boost".
* The '''[[List of QuadDrive System parts|QuadDrive System]]''', which is based on the Dynamite Battle Layer System, introduces Beyblades with two modes for the Layers, "Apex Mode" and "Core Mode", and two modes for the Drivers, "Normal Mode" and "Plus Mode". This creates a total of "4 ways to customize" a QuadDrive System Beyblade.
* The '''[[List of QuadDrive System parts|QuadStrike System]]''', which is based on the Burst Ultimate Layer Series, introduces the "QuadStrike Armor Tip", a new version of Armor Tips.
* The '''[[List of Pro Series System parts|Pro Series System]]''', which is comprised of Hasbro releases of various repackaged Takara Tomy Beyblades from the Cho-Z, Gatinko, and Superking Layer Systems. Beginning in 2023 with the Superking Layer System releases, the Takara Tomy logo is now displayed on the packaging.

==Structure==
The basic structure of a Burst System Beyblade consists of three main components: the Layer (Energy Layer), the Disc (Forge Disc), and the Driver (Performance Tip).

===Layer===
'''Layers''' (known as '''Energy Layers''' by Hasbro) are the part on the top of the Beyblade that makes all the contact with opposing Beyblades. Typically, a Layer is made of a texturized transparent casing with a colored piece screwed underneath, acting as a visualization of the weight distribution. Both components are made of polycarbonate (PC) plastic, but the bottom one is softer. In some cases, the colored segment protrudes from the sides or from the top through holes in the clear cover, in order to provide a little more shock absorption.

On the colored piece of plastic that is underneath, a ring is formed in the center to be able to see the Driver's letter through the hole, and also to house the Burst mechanism.

In Takara Tomy releases, the Layer also includes an NFC chip. This chip can be exclusively scanned at [[BeyTerminal]] arcade machines in Japan, allowing a Blader to play the virtual game and win prizes.

The Layer also includes a design that features the beast that it is based upon. For example, the [[Layer - Unicrest|Unicrest Layer]] includes the head of the unicorn within its design, and the horn serves as a contact point for the part.

Beginning with the Gatinko Layer System (Takara Tomy) and the HyperSphere System (Hasbro), Layers became more customizable with the Layer splitting into several parts.

===Disc===
'''Discs''' (known as '''Forge Discs''' by Hasbro) are the part in the middle of a Beyblade that serves as its weight. Discs are made of metal and are not designed to make contact with another Beyblade unless it is wobbling.

Discs come in various shapes and sizes, each having a different weight and distribution to suit a variety of needs. '''Core Discs''' are Discs that have the ability to attach [[Frames]] for further customization.

===Driver===
'''Drivers''' (known as '''Performance Tips''' by Hasbro) are the part at the bottom of a Beyblade that serves as its main form of movement and contact with the Beystadium floor.

Most of the Drivers released are of the same height, unlike in previous Beyblade series. They are shaped like an upside-down pyramid and house a spring system that is essential for the Burst mechanism thanks to the interaction of the white tabs at its top and the Layer's inner sets of tee

[[File:HasbroLogo2020.png|thumb|Current Hasbro Logo (2010s)]]
'''Hasbro''' is an American toy company that was founded in 1923. It serves as the distributor and manufacturer of [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] products in North America, and most other western countries in the world. Hasbro currently produces and distributes the Beyblade toyline under the license from [[Takara Tomy]].

Besides production, Hasbro also hosts Beyblade tournaments among other events. They are one of the largest toy companies in the world, alongside Mattel.

==Trivia==
[[File:Hasbro-logo.jpg|thumb|Hasbro Logo (2000s)]]
*Hasbro releases generally use the international names given to them by [[ADK Emotions Inc.]], although occasionally releases will instead use a name from Hasbro themselves.
**For example, "[[Burning Kerberous]]" was localized as "Burning Cerberus" by ADK Emotions, and released by Hasbro as "Howling Spirit".
**"[[Rage Longinus Destroy' 3A|Rage Longinus]]" was localized as "Raid Lúinor" by ADK Emotions, but the existence of Hasbro's [[SpeedStorm System]] "[[Raid Luinor L6 3A-D Destroy-SPM|Raid Lúinor]]" resulted in the former being released by Hasbro as "Rage Lúinor".
**Some localization changes either censor certain words such as "hell", or simplify names.
**For the ''[[Beyblade X (toyline)|Beyblade X]]'' toyline, most of the names are swapped around, making the model name come before the motif name. For example, "DranSword" is renamed "Sword Dran", but "CobaltDragoon" remains "Cobalt Dragoon", with the addition of the space between words.

}}{{Translation|'''Acid Anubis'''|アシッドアヌビス|Ashiddo Anubisu}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-71 Booster, [[Acid Anubis Yell Orbit]], on February 18th, 2017.

==Description ==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the guardian deity of the underworld, Anubis. A right-spin Defense Type Dual Layer that can disperse attacks with its lower blade made up of fine protrusions and has a small, circular shape that makes it difficult for the opponent to shake its axis.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Acid Anubis''' is a round and slim Layer designed for Defense. The center of the Layer depicts a jackal like its namesake; the Egyptian god of the afterlife, Anubis.

Consisting of a colored, six segmented bottom layer and a clear, six pointed top layer, every segment of the bottom layer has four small protrusions and each gap between the segments is filled in with one of the points of the top layer.

Due to the round design of the Layer, '''Acid Anubis''' has little recoil and decent Defensive properties and its weight distribution gives the Layer a strong Flywheel Effect and Stamina. Furthermore, the small bumps on '''Acid Anubis''' allows for some degree of Destabilization akin to [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]]. However, '''Acid Anubis'''<nowiki/>' Burst Resistance lags behind [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] and [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]] due to the average teeth and lack of deflectional blades.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Acid Anubis''' was a great Layer for Stamina Combinations, capable of Out-Spinning commonly used Layers such as [[Layer - Odin|Odin]], [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]] and [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] with its ability to Destabilize the opponent and strong Flywheel Effect. However, with its weak Burst Resistance and the release of the much heavier SwitchStrike/God Layers such as [[Layer - Guardian Kerbeus|Guardian Kerbeus]] and [[Layer - Deep Chaos|Deep Chaos]], '''Acid Anubis''' has become outclassed. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Acid Anubis is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Amaterios'''|アマテリオス|Amateriosu}}, stylized as '''αmaterios''', is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-00α [[Rare Bey Get Battle (Burst)|Rare Bey Get Battle]] Exclusive Booster, [[Amaterios Aero Assault]], in August 2015.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the sun goddess, Amaterasu. A right-spin Attack Type Layer that specializes in Bursting opponents with its five blades that create super powerful Upper Attacks.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Amaterios''' is an Attack Type Layer that features a face on the left side, meant to represent this Layer's namesake; the Shinto Goddess of the Sun Amaterasu, and an overall pentagonal or star shape. Such a shape creates five points of recoil which grants '''Amaterios''' high Burst and Knock-Out potential while the tall teeth are capable of withstanding the Layer's recoil. Furthermore, among the Single Layers, '''Amaterios''' has high weight which further bolsters Burst Resistance and Attack potential.

However, '''Amaterios''' lags behind [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] and [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] in Attack Combinations as the pentagonal shape means that each point of contact is at an obtuse angle which reduces recoil compared to the triangular [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] or the sword point of [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]]. Furthermore, as a pre-Xcalibur Single Layer, '''Amaterios'''<nowiki/>' teeth will wear down quickly with use, so if one prefers to use '''Amaterios''', it is recommended to have multiple copies of this Layer and to be prepared to replace it.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Attack Combinations==
'''Amaterios''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination '''Amaterios''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Assault|Assault]]/[[Driver - Iron|Iron]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]. The heavy weight of [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]]/[[Frame - Star|Star]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]] bolsters '''Amaterios'''<nowiki/>' Burst potential while the Layer's strong teeth can compensate for the increased Burst risk. The high speed of [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Assault|Assault]]/[[Driver - Iron|Iron]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] further adds to the Combination's Burst potential while [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Assault|Assault]]/[[Driver - Iron|Iron]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] can add greater Stamina and the potential to counter Tornado Staller Combinations.

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Amaterios''' features a high recoil design, strong teeth and heavy weight for its time. However, the obtuse angles of the pentagonal shape made '''Amaterios''' outclassed by [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] and [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]]. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Amaterios''' is now too light to remain viable in the current metagame. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Amaterios is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Attack Type Dual Layer that is equipped with a lower blade that can launch repeated attacks from all directions and an upper blade that can launch a powerful upper attack with its five large horns.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Beast Behemoth''' is an overall round Layer, the center of the Layer depicts a beast, like the Layer's namesake, biting down on the circle where the "B" of the Layer resides.

Consisting of a colored bottom layer made up of two jaw like arches and a clear top layer consisting of five, widely spaced blades creating a pinwheel-esque look, the "jaws" and ends of the clear blades of the Layer are covered in small serrations like teeth. While these features may imply that this Layer has a lot or recoil, the height of the Layer means that typically both layers come into contact with the opposing Beyblade and fill in each other's gaps and the slight serrations are too small to cause any noticeable recoil and subsequent Stamina loss.

'''Beast Behemoth''' also features three tall teeth akin to [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]], allowing it to be used in Defense Combinations with its moderately low recoil.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Beast Behemoth''' was a decent Layer for Defense Combinations due to its strong teeth and relatively round shape. However, it was outclassed by [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]] and with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Beast Behemoth''' is too light to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Beast Behemoth is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Burn Phoenix'''|バーンフェニックス|Bān Fenikkusu}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-158 [[Random Booster Vol. 19]] on February 22nd, 2020.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Burn Phoenix''' is a Stamina Type Layer that adapts the [[Face Bolt - Phoenix|Phoenix Face]], [[Energy Ring - Phoenix|Phoenix Clear Wheel]], and [[Fusion Wheel - Burn|Burn Metal Wheel]] of the [[Metal Series]]' [[Hybrid Wheel System]] for the [[Burst System]]. As such, '''Burn Phoenix''' resembles the general shape of these parts, with a design consisting of wings and tails of a phoenix, and a circular perimeter with two sets of wave-like ridges. The three parts are noninterchangeable and combined into a single piece. The Phoenix motif adorns the center of the Layer, with the word "Phoenix" on the sides. Compared to the original parts, the '''Burn Phoenix''' Layer is much wider - the "Metal Wheel" portion of the Layer is made of plastic, with metal lining the circumference. '''Burn Phoenix''' has poor Burst Resistance due to its fine locks.

'''Burn Phoenix''' initially saw little usage in tournaments at the time of its release, due to its light weight. Stamina Type Gatinko Layers such as Master Diabolos were 7 grams heavier, almost a quarter of the weight. However, changes in Stadiums used in official [[World Beyblade Battling Association|wbba.]] tournaments held by Takara Tomy created suitable conditions for '''Burn Phoenix''' to be used in a niche capacity. The [[Dash Beystadium]] and [[Beystadium DB Standard Type]] had larger Battle Areas, discouraging the use of Attack Types and making Stamina Type matchups common. As a result, '''Burn Phoenix''' became a viable deck option for [[5G Battle]]; the circular perimeter of '''Burn Phoenix''' was decent against wide Same-Spin opponents, and also stayed sturdy due to the smoothness of the perimeter. However, its poor Burst Resistance and low weight meant '''Burn Phoenix''' was not a dominant Layer, and it saw nearly no play in [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) tournaments, where the battle format was primarily [[1on1 Battle]], [[3on3 Battle]], or [[Deck Battle]].</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Burst=
Due to its light weight, '''Burn Phoenix''' is outclassed by heavier Dynamite Battle Layers in the format.

'''As such, Burn Phoenix is not recommended for the WBO's Burst format.'''
|-|Burst GT=
With its circular perimeter, '''Burn Phoenix''' can be used in Same-Spin matchups, particularly in Stadiums with larger Battle Areas. It is however vulnerable to several Attack Type combinations, and heavier Stamina Type combinations.

'''As such, Burn Phoenix is not a must-have, but a welcome addition for the WBO's Burst GT format.'''
|-|Burst Limited=
'''Burn Phoenix''' is not legal in the WBO's Burst Limited format.
<nowiki/>
|-|Burst Classic=
'''Burn Phoenix''' is not legal in the WBO's Burst Classic format.
<nowiki/>
</tabber>

}}{{Translation|'''Chaos'''|カオス|Kaosu}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan as the prize Layer in BG-01 [[Random Layer Collection Vol. 1]] in December 2015.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the god of chaos, Chaos. A right-spin Stamina Type Layer with two large, round blades that can generate high centrifugal force, and a tall trapezoidal shape that makes it difficult to lose rotational force.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Chaos''' forms a nearly perfect circle, with two "wings" separated by two gaps. Each wing has two larger indentations and one smaller one, and the gaps between the wings each have a head-like design representing its legendary warrior. Its transparent casing is tinted black, and it has white-colored plastic underneath, concentrated around the Layer's perimeter.

Although its circular shape is almost ideal, the gaps and notches on this Layer's exterior do cause some recoil and provide leverage for opposing Beyblades. However, its biggest flaw is the teeth on its underside's center: they are all much shorter than the ring in the middle, which greatly reduces the resistance to rotation between the Performance Tip and the Layer. This results in extremely easy teeth skipping and, ultimately, losses by Burst. It is such a problem that, even though it is great in Stamina when it does escape without Bursting in battle, it represents such an immense risk that it is generally not recommended for top-tier Combinations. However, the Stamina Combination '''Chaos''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] [[Driver - Defense|Defense]] can be used by daring Bladers as a good alternative.

There are three mold variations of '''Chaos''': the first mold has four teeth of equal size, and no symbol in the center of the layer. The second mold, introduced with Asian releases of '''Chaos''', has a taller third tooth, increasing the Burst Resistance of the Layer. In addition, it features a "C" in the center of the Layer, akin to Dual Layers. The third mold, introduced with the Soul Gold Ver., retains the second mold's additions, as well as additional reinforcing plastic posts inside the wings, increasing the Layer's weight by half a gram.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Chaos''' cannot be overlooked due to its remarkable endurance abilities, it poses such a high risk due to the ease with which it can be Burst that it is not fit to be top-tier.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Chaos is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Dark Deathscyther'''|ダークデスサイザー|Dāku Desusaizā}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-42 Booster, [[Dark Deathscyther Force Jaggy]], on April 29th, 2016.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the grim reaper, Deathscyther. A right-spin Attack Type Dual Layer in which the upper and lower blades, which are roughly divided into two halves, cut through the Beyblade's opponent.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Dark Deathscyther''', like its predecessor [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]], is an Attack Type Layer that features four smooth sided, compact blades. Two of the blades are made of colored plastic with a sloped design that allow for small amounts of Upper Attack and Destabilization, the other two are made of transparent plastic and are not sloped, meant for Burst Attack. 

Despite being advertised as an Attack Type Layer, '''Dark Deathscyther''' does not perform well in Attack Combinations but excels in both Stamina and Defense Combinations due to its incredibly round design. Because the blades are so compact, the protrusions are incredibly shallow and create little recoil, that along with the Layer's strong teeth makes it very resistant to Bursts and Knock-Outs. In comparison to its predecessor, '''Dark Deathscyther'''<nowiki/>'s Flywheel Effect is not as great as [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]], but it is still comparable and unlike [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]], this Layer's teeth will not wear down with use.

However, '''Dark Deathscyther''' has a history of breaking. There is one mold variation in an attempt to fix this issue where the plastic was made thicker and reinforced with bars. However this did not solve the breakage problem, so it is recommended to find a second generation Layer and to be prepared to replace it.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Stamina Combinations==
'''Dark Deathscyther''' can be put to use in the Stationary Stamina Combination '''Dark Deathscyther''' [[Disc - Spread|Spread]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]] [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]/[[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]. Due to [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]'s high Precession time and [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit's]] free rotating nature, the Combination is able to withstand hits without major Stamina loss. In addition, the wide ring around [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]] and [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]'s ball shaped tip increase the Combination's Defense.

==Use in Mobile Stamina Combinations==
'''Dark Deathscyther''' is capable of Out-Spinning opponents by avoiding contact with them in the Mobile Stamina Combination '''Dark Deathscyther''' [[Disc - Spread|Spread]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]] [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]].

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Dark Deathscyther''' was a top-tier and commonly available Layer for Stamina Combinations and was a key part in the Burst metagame to the point of previously being banned. However, with the release of the much heavier SwitchStrike/God Layers such as [[Layer - Alter Chronos|Alter Chronos]] and [[Layer - Maximum Garuda|Maximum Garuda]], '''Dark Deathscyther'''<nowiki/>'s comparatively light weight makes it far less useful in the current metagame. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Dark Deathscyther is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to any blader's collection.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the grim reaper, Deathscyther. A right-spin Attack Type Layer that breaks the rotation balance with a continuous attack from its four blades to burst the opponent.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Deathscyther''' features a four-bladed design with very smooth sides. It is based off of common depictions of Death as an entity with a skeletal design that uses scythes to attack. As such, the Layer features a hooded skull design.

The colored plastic underneath the transparent casing is focused in the center as well as on half of the perimeter and its three teeth are in descending order, meaning that the first one is very tall, that the second tooth is just slightly shorter than the surrounding ring in the middle and that the third one is small.

Due to its smooth features and the weight concentration that allows for a Flywheel Effect, it excels in Stamina. Without huge impacts with momentum, opponents are unable to use one of its protrusions to Destabilize it or push it in reverse to make it skip over one of its teeth, especially since the first one in the series is tall, following the trait of Layers labeled as Attack Types by the producer. Therefore, in a Stamina battle, it holds its ground and can spin almost undisturbed until the end.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Stamina Combinations==
'''Deathscyther''' can be put to good use in the Stamina Combination '''Deathscyther '''[[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Ring|Ring]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]] [[Driver - Defense|Defense]]/[[Driver - Survive|Survive]]. Since [[Driver - Defense|Defense]] provides slightly more Stability than [[Driver - Survive|Survive]], it is able to withstand some hits and suspend the Precession for as long as possible.

In Mobile Stamina Combinations, '''Deathscyther''' is also capable of Out-Spinning opponents by avoiding contact with them, such as in the '''Deathscyther '''[[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]]/[[Disc - Ring|Ring]] [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Blow|Blow]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] Combination.

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Deathscyther''' was once a top-tier choice for Stamina Combinations to the point of once being banned. While now legal for tournament play once more, the release of the heavier SwitchStrike/God Layer System has made '''Deathscyther''' too light to remain competitive. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Deathscyther is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Draciel Shield''' is a [[Burst System]] adaptation of the [[Attack Ring - Cross Spike|Cross Spike]] Attack Ring and [[Bit Chip - Draciel|Draciel]] Bit Chip from the [[Original Series]]' [[Spin Gear System]]. As such it features an overall square/diamond shape with four projected turtle heads with flat spikes which act as the main contact points with an image of the Bit Beast Draciel in the center. The only differences between the Layer and original Attack Ring is that the four turtle heads are more compact making the Layer somewhat smaller than the Attack Ring and the "Bit Chip" is non-removable. '''Draciel Shield''' features teeth comparable to those of [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]].

The pointed design of the Layer makes '''Draciel Shield''' ill-suited for Defense or Stamina Combinations and instead function akin to a four pointed [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]]. While this may imply high Attack potential, '''Draciel Shield''' is crippled by its hollow construction which makes it one of the lightest Layers in the game. The light weight creates low inertia, which when coupled with the high recoil design, leaves the teeth incapable of compensating and thus '''Draciel Shield''' is highly prone to Bursts.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Due to the light weight and recoil heavy design, Takara Tomy's '''Draciel Shield''' is too Burst prone to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Draciel Shield is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-00 CoroCoro Exclusive Booster, [[Dragoon Fantom Gravity Variable]] (Aniki Ver.), in December 2017.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Dragoon Fantom''' is a [[Burst System]] adaptation of the Dual Dragon Attack Ring and Dragoon Bit Chip from the [[Original Series]]' [[Spin Gear System]]. As such it features an overall square/diamond shape with four dragon heads that act as the main contact points and an image of the Bit Beast Dragoon in the center. The only differences between the Layer and the original Attack Ring is that the dragon heads are more compact making the Layer somewhat smaller overall and the "Bit Chip" is irremovable.

'''Dragoon Fantom''' features teeth comparable to those on [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]], while such teeth would normally allow a Layer to withstand its own recoil, the pointed shape of each of the heads are so recoil heavy and the Layer is so light in weight due to being so thin, hollow and made from only one layer of plastic that the teeth are still unable to compensate in almost any circumstance.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Dragoon Fantom''' has strong teeth, its shape is simply too aggressive and its weight is too light to be effective, a factor that is exacerbated with the heavier SwitchStrike/God Layer System. As such, '''Dragoon Fantom''' is outclassed by other Layers for Left-Spin Attack such as [[Layer - Nightmare Longinus|Nightmare Longinus]] and [[Layer - Legend Spriggan|Legend Spriggan]].

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Dragoon Fantom is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
