<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Dranzer Flame''' Layer is a [[Burst System]] adaptation of the Flame Wing Attack Ring and Dranzer Bit Chip from the [[Original Series]]' [[Spin Gear System]]. As such it features an overall elliptical shape with two bird heads and wings on either side which act as the main points of contact creating an aggressive, recoil heavy shape and an image of the Bit Beast Dranzer in the center. Such weight generates little inertia making this Layer very Burst prone despite the strong teeth.</onlyinclude>

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Driger Slash''' is a [[Burst System]] adaptation of the Tiger Defenser Attack Ring and Driger Bit Chip from the [[Original Series]]' [[Spin Gear System]]. As such, it features an overall elliptical shape with two tiger heads with large wings that form the main points of contact and an image of the Bit Beast Driger in the center. The only differences between the Layer and the original Attack Ring is that the Layer is much thicker overall, the wings are slightly more compact making the Layer somewhat smaller, the wings no longer have Upper Attack slopes and the "Bit Chip" is non-removable. '''Driger Slash''' features four teeth, the first is medium in length, the next three are tall in length, so tall that there have been reports of the Layer "sticking" in between clicks.

While the elliptical shape and large wings of '''Driger Slash''' may imply heavy recoil and high levels of Burst Attack, in reality the points of contact are actually compact due to their acute angle and thus reduce this Layer's recoil to below that of [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]]'s. Furthermore, the Burst Resistance of its teeth is mitigated by the Layer's light weight caused by its hollow construction. While '''Driger Slash''' can have some potential in Anti-Attack Combinations against [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] and [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] by catching their points of contact and Bursting them against its own Burst Resistance, with the release of the heavier SwitchStrike/God Layer System, this niche use is no longer viable.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Driger Slash'''<nowiki/>'s strong teeth made it the most viable of the four original re-releases, it still has the same problem of light weight from its hollow design. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, this flaw has become crippling. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Driger Slash is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-198 [[Random Booster Vol. 29]] on May 28th, 2022. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = The motif is of the four sacred beasts, Driger. The large two upper-shaped blades handle both Attack and Defense. The Beyblade's performance is improved by installing support parts in the lower row of the Layer. |speaker = Official Description}} Takara Tomy's '''Driger V2''' or '''Driger Vulcan 2''' is a [[Burst System]] adaptation of the [[Bit Chip - Driger|Driger]] Bit Chip, [[Attack Ring - Upper Claw|Upper Claw]] Attack Ring, and [[Support Parts - Upper Attack|Upper Attack]] Support Parts that came with the [[Original Series]]' [[Magnacore System]] Beyblade, [[Driger V2]]. As such, it features two tiger heads, followed by long slopes that enable [[Upper Attack]]. Compared to the original Upper Claw Attack Ring, '''Driger V2''' is more circular, and the tiger heads have been elongated. A non-removable metal "Bit Chip" is molded into the center of the Layer, and depicts the Driger Bit Beast. The main section of the Layer has an overall elliptical shape, akin to the original Upper Claw Attack Ring. Due to the design of the Burst System, the ''Support Parts'' included with '''Driger V2''' is one piece, rather than the two pieces of the original Upper Attack Support Parts. Like the original Upper Attack Support Parts, the included ''Support Parts'' extend the slopes of the main section, adding Upper Attack capabilities at a lower height. When the ''Support Parts'' are used, '''Driger V2''' is only compatible with [[List of Dynamite Battle Layer System parts#Forge Discs|DB Discs]] and [[List of QuadDrive System parts#Forge Discs|QD Discs]]. When used without the ''Support Parts'', any Disc can be used with '''Driger V2'''. Due to its overall round shape when used with its ''Support Parts'', '''Driger V2''' excels in Stamina Combinations utilizing top tier Drivers such as [[Driver - Bearing'|Bearing']] and [[Driver - High Xtend+'|High Xtend+']]. Of the Original Series remakes, '''Driger V2''' is the heaviest and most competitive, with performance comparable to [[Gatinko Layer System|Gatinko Layers]]. As such, '''Driger V2''' holds the distinction of being the only Original Series remake that is banned from the WBO's Burst Limited Format. ==Overall== |-|Burst= Compared to Dynamite Battle Layers, '''Driger V2''' is too light to compete in the format. However, if a Blader chooses to use Driger V2, it is recommended that heavy and circular DB Discs such as [[Disc - Over|Over]] and [[Disc - Illegal|Illegal]] be used. '''As such, Driger V2 is not recommended for the Burst Format.''' |-|Burst GT= '''Driger V2''' has a weight comparable to other Layers in the WBO's Burst GT Format and can compete against Gatinko Layers. Its round shape makes it an ideal Layer to use in Stamina Combinations. '''Driger V2''' works best with Hasbro's round QD Discs, such as [[Disc - Tapered-Q|Tapered-Q]]. '''As such, Driger V2 is a must have for the Burst GT Format.''' |-|Burst Limited= '''Driger V2''' is not legal in the WBO's Burst Limited Format. |-|Burst Classic= '''Driger V2''' is not legal in the WBO's Burst Classic Format. ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * B-198 [[Random Booster Vol. 29]] - 03: [[Driger V2 Over Wedge']] * B-00 [[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade 2023 V2 Set]] - [[Driger V2 Illegal Wedge']] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== LayerDrigerV2.png|Driger V2 (B-198) Driger V2.Il.Wd'.jpeg|Driger V2 (B-00) ==Trivia== * '''Driger V2''' was a strong contender in the WBO's Burst Limited Format upon its release, where it remained a top tier pick until it was banned from the format 5 months later on October 25th, 2022. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Takara Tomy Exclusives]]

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Earth Aquila''' is a [[Layer]] that adapts the [[Face Bolt - Aquila|Aquila Face Bolt]], [[Energy Ring - Aquila|Aquila Energy Ring]], and [[Fusion Wheel - Earth|Earth Fusion Wheel]] of the [[Metal Series]]' [[Hybrid Wheel System]] for the [[Burst System]]. The three parts are noninterchangeable and combined into a single piece. The Aquila motif adorns the center of the Layer, with the words "Hybrid" and "Wheel" featured on the sides, referencing the Hybrid Wheel System. Compared to the original parts, the '''Earth Aquila''' Layer is noticeably wider - the "Fusion Wheel" portion of the Layer is made of plastic, with metal lining the circumference. '''Earth Aquila''' has particularly poor Burst Resistance, due to its fine locks.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Standard=
Like other Burst System remakes, Takara Tomy's '''Earth Aquila''' is outclassed in the current metagame by recent releases from Takara Tomy.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Earth Aquila is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
|-|Limited=

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Earth Aquila is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Evil-eye'''|イビルアイ|Ibiruai}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-24 [[Random Booster Vol. 2 Evil-eye Wing Needle]] on December 26th, 2015.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Defense Type Layer that aims for a counter with a round and hard body like the eyes of a devil.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Evil-eye''' is a round Layer designed for Defense that features a coiled serpent around the perimeter and molding around the center akin to the Iris of the eye. The design features the [[wikipedia:Evil eye|evil-eye]], a supernatural curse originating from Mediterranean cultures, and a coiled serpent representing the [[wikipedia:Ouroboros|Ouroboros]] eating its own tail.

The perimeter features twelve blades, that at first glance appears to create a rough, high recoil design. However, the direction of the blades means that impacts are instead deflected off of '''Evil-eye''', reducing recoil. '''Evil-eye''' also features four teeth of medium length, allowing the Layer to withstand the recoil it does produce.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Due to this Layer's low recoil and strong teeth, Takara Tomy's '''Evil-eye''' was a Layer great for Defense Combinations, however it was still outclassed by other, more commonly available Layers such as [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]] and [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] due to its relatively rougher design. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Evil-eye''' is now too light to stay competitive. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Evil-eye is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}'''Evipero''' is a [[Layer]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in western countries with the release of the Starter Pack, [[Evipero Wing Needle]].

==Description==
<onlyinclude>In-depth information for Hasbro's '''Evipero''' Layer will be placed here once drafting has been completed for it. Please be patient.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Hasbro's '''Evipero''' features strong slopes, and combined with the unchanged design compared to Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Evil-eye|Evil-eye]], it created a top-tier Layer for Defense Combinations with excellent Stamina. However, its rough design made it outclassed by [[Layer - Unicrest|Unicrest]]. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Evipero''' is now too light to remain competitive.

'''As such, Hasbro's Evipero is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Use in Defense Combinations==
'''Evipero''' can be put to use in the Defense Combination '''Evipero''' [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]/[[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]/[[Driver - Press|Press]]/[[Driver - Needle|Needle]]. [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]] bolsters Burst Resistance and Stamina and [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] bolsters Knock-Out Resistance and Stamina while '''Evipero'''<nowiki/>'s strong slopes can compensate for the increased Burst risk. [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]] increases Stamina while the Layer and Disc reduce recoil while Hasbro's [[Driver - Press|Press]]/[[Driver - Needle|Needle]]'s tabs and strong spring increases Knock-Out and Burst Resistance.

}}{{Translation|'''Exceed Evil-eye'''|イクシードイビルアイ|Ikushīdo Ibiruai}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BG-04 [[Random Layer Collection Vol. 4]] on October 24th, 2016.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of Evil-eye. A right-spin Defense Type Dual Layer that aims to counterattack by hollowing out the inside of its rugged defense blade.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Exceed Evil-eye''' is a Defense Type Layer with the center of it featuring the head of a horned serpent  representing [[wikipedia:Ouroboros|Ouroboros]], and molding akin to the iris of an eye, representing the [[wikipedia:Evil eye|evil-eye]], a supernatural curse originating from Mediterranean cultures.

The Layer's perimeter is made up of six blades, three made of colored plastic and three made of clear plastic. The colored blades are wide and make up most of the perimeter, while the clear blades are small and party fill up the gaps in between the colored blades.

Despite the resemblance, '''Exceed Evil-eye''' has poor performance due to the Layer's mediocre teeth and recoil inducing design caused the large gaps. However, the shape allows '''Exceed Evil-eye''' to act as a consistent counter against [[Layer - Maximum Garuda|Maximum Garuda]], catching into [[Layer - Maximum Garuda|Maximum Garuda]]'s notches and Bursting it, though such usefulness is niche.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Exceed Evil-eye''' features a design too recoil heavy for Defense and teeth too short for Attack. Furthermore, with the release of SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Exceed Evil-eye''' is too light to stay competitive. While it can act as consistent counter against the top-tier [[Layer - Maximum Garuda|Maximum Garuda]], such usefulness is niche and '''Exceed Evil-eye'''<nowiki/>'s weak performance would make it a risk in tournament use. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Exceed Evil-eye is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Gigant Gaia'''|ギガントガイア|Giganto Gaia}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-67 [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]] on December 28th, 2016.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Balance Type Layer that has both defensive and endurance abilities with its rugged, continuously-attacking blade and its thick, centrifugal blade.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Gigant Gaia''' is a Balance Type Layer featuring two rows of four blades resembling stones, two golem heads on either sides like the Layer's namesake, the Greek Primordial Deity Gaia, and a large 'G' around the center of the Layer.

The direction, shape and downward angle of the two rows of "stones" are similar to the blades of [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] except that the stones are much thicker and the angle that they protrude from is more obtuse, like the blades of [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]]. The sides two golem heads create points of Burst Attack and the top of the heads create a smooth, low-recoil surface. This is meant to give '''Gigant Gaia''' a mix of Defense and Attack properties, however, the angle and spacing between the stones are too small for decent Attack potential.

Instead, '''Gigant Gaia'''<nowiki/>'s potential lies within Defense; the stones deflect attacks creating a low recoil surface perfect for Knock-Out Defense Combinations and the teeth on '''Gigant Gaia''' alternate between "medium tall" to "short" giving '''Gigant Gaia''' strong Burst Resistance, greater than [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] due to the similar blades and stronger teeth. However, this Layer's Stamina is only average compared to Layers such as [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]], [[Layer - Odin|Odin]] or [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]], giving combinations using '''Gigant Gaia''' a risk of being Out-Spun.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Defense Combinations==
'''Gigant Gaia''' can be used in the Defense Combination '''Gigant Gaia''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]] [[Driver - Unite|Unite]]/[[Driver - Bite|Bite]]/[[Driver - Defense|Defense]]. The heavy weight of [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]] further bolsters '''Gigant Gaia'''<nowiki/>'s Knock-Out Resistance and Stamina while the Layer's teeth can compensate for the greater Burst risk. [[Driver - Unite|Unite]]/[[Driver - Bite|Bite]] adds greater Knock-Out Resistance but reduces Stamina, [[Driver - Defense|Defense]] can bolster Knock-Out Resistance, Stamina and Burst Resistance but not to the same degree as the other Drivers.

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Gigant Gaia''' is a great Layer for Defense with strong Knock-Out Resistance and stronger Burst Resistance. However, the Layer is still outclassed by [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]], [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]] and [[Layer - Odin|Odin]] due to its only average Stamina. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Gigant Gaia''' has become too light to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Gigant Gaia is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the sky god, Horusood. A right-spin Stamina Type Dual Layer in which its thick armored upper blade creates a centrifugal force while scraping the opponent's stamina with the fine wings of its lower blade.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Holy Horusood''' is a Stamina Type Layer that features a bird in the center looking left, shown with the Eye of Horus and four feathered blades that make up the bird's wings, two of which consist of clear plastic and two of which consist of colored plastic that are waved. All meant to represent the Layer's namesake; Horus, the falcon headed Egyptian god.

Like [[Layer - Wild Wyvern|Wild Wyvern]], while '''Holy Horusood''' seems round at first glance, but upon closer inspection its actually square in shape. Each of the corners of this square-like shape and the waves of the two colored blades create points of recoil that make it unsuitable for Stamina Combinations, while the waved blades do allow for some degree of Destabilization, the feathered design makes them too rough to be suited for such a purpose. This problem is further exacerbated by the fact that it features four teeth, the first short in length, and the last three are medium-short in length. As such, it is prone to losses by Bursts, as the teeth are unable to withstand the recoil the Layer creates.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Holy Horusood''' suffers from a recoil producing design and average teeth unable to withstand the recoil. While the waved design can produce some Destabilization, they too are unreliable for such a purpose. Furthermore, with the release of Cho-Z Layers such as [[Layer - Hell Salamander|Hell Salamander]] and [[Layer - Archer Hercules|Archer Hercules]], '''Holy Horusood''' is far too light to be competitive. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Holy Horusood is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the flame spirit, Ifrit. A right-spin Balance Type Dual Layer that combines the offensive and defensive capabilities of six hits with its upper and lower blades.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Inferno Ifrit''' is a triangular Layer made for Attack, the perimeter of which features three triangles and three pointed blades creating the primary points of impact, one of the triangles making up the upper jaw and one of the blades of which makes up the lower jaw of the Layer's namesake, the Ifrit, the supernatural creature of fire from Islamic Scripture.

The pointed shape and direction of the blades implies a high recoil design that excels in Burst Attack, while the downward slope of the blades allows for small amounts of Force Smash and Destabilization and the three triangles are pointed downward so they do not cover up the blades. '''Inferno Ifrit''' features four teeth, the first of which is short in length and the last three are tall in length, allowing this Layer to withstand its own recoil. However, '''Inferno Ifrit'''<nowiki/>'s blades are in reality, compact which limits the recoil and the Layer suffers a history of breaks and no mold variations have been released to solve that problem. It is recommended to have multiple copies of this Layer and to be prepared to replace it.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Standard=
With the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, Takara Tomy's '''Inferno Ifrit''' is too light to remain competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Inferno Ifrit is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
|-|Limited=
Takara Tomy's '''Inferno Ifrit''' is too light to compete with other Layers in the format.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Inferno Ifrit is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
|-|Classic=
Due to this Layer's moderate recoil and Burst Attack, Takara Tomy's '''Inferno Ifrit''' is a decent choice for Attack Combinations. While it is outclassed by [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] for Attack Combinations, it does not suffer from the teeth breakage issue of Valkyrie, and thus can be used if mint copies of Valkyrie are unavailable.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Inferno Ifrit is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.'''
</tabber>

}}{{Translation|'''Kaiser Kerbeus'''|カイザーケルベウス|Kaizā Kerubeusu}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-37 Booster, [[Kaiser Kerbeus Limited Press]], on April 2nd, 2016.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the guard dog of the underworld, Kerbeus. A right-spin Defense Type Dual Layer with a full defense against repeated hits with its six upper blades and a super defense with the twelve lower chain type blades.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Kaiser Kerbeus''', like its predecessor [[Layer - Kerbeus (Takara Tomy)|Kerbeus]], is a round and thin Layer designed for Defense. As such, its design consists of a six-bladed top-layer made of clear plastic; that each have a large gap in between, and a round bottom-layer made of colored plastic that's molded into the shape of chains; with each "link" of the chain-like layer slightly protruding outwards. In the center of the Layer are three dogs heads with flames near each head, representing the Layer's namesake; Kerberos, the three-headed guard dog of the Underworld featured in Greek mythology. 

At first glance, the design of '''Kaiser Kerbeus''', while round, appears to imply high recoil. However in reality, due to how thin the Layer is, both the clear and colored plastic layers come into contact with the opponent's Layer at the same time and cover each other's gaps in the process, and as such, is capable of reducing recoil and potential subsequent Stamina loss. Its strong teeth made it excel in Defense Combinations when in certain conditions. However, while this may imply high Defense potential, there are two major weaknesses: 

First, when the '''Kaiser Kerbeus''' Combination is knocked off balance, only the six-bladed top-layer will come into contact with the opponent. As such, due to the aforementioned large gaps in between each blade, this increases the risk of the '''Kaiser Kerbeus''' Combination Bursting. As such, it is critical to pair up '''Kaiser Kerbeus''' will a Performance Tip with great Stability. 

Finally, the weight distribution of the Layer ends up creating poor Stamina, making '''Kaiser Kerbeus''' Combinations liable to being Out-Spun.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Kaiser Kerbeus''' was a great and commonly available Layer for Defense, however with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Kaiser Kerbeus''' is now too light to be competitive. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Kaiser Kerbeus is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the guard dog of the underworld, Kerbeus. A right-spin Defense Type Layer with a chain blade placed on the outside that catches attacks.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Kerbeus''' is a circular shaped Layer designed for Defense. '''Kerbeus'''<nowiki/>' center, as the name states, depicts a 3-headed dog-like monster named Cerberus spitting flames. Two of the heads represented by the colored plastic underneath the transparent casing are located on one side, while the third is located on the opposite side. Theoretically, this would leave the Layer unbalanced, but in reality the effect is so minuscule that it shouldn't be considered a fault in competitive play. '''Kerbeus'''<nowiki/>' rim has 16 protrusions, with half of the protrusions being larger. In theory, this characteristic would grind the opponent's Layer, but in reality it has the reverse effect and that makes it prone to loss by Out-Spin and the uneven surface adds recoil. '''Kerbeus''' does, however, have decent Stamina and Defense abilities granted by its circular shape.

It was particularly hard to Burst and had a mostly balanced design but, due to the release of newer Layers, '''Kerbeus''' has been overshadowed. These are reasons which add to this Layer's position as now outclassed in all categories.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Kerbeus''' is a Layer that is great in theory, but does not execute as well in reality. '''Kerbeus''' was no doubt the first go-to Layer for Defense and Stamina Combinations, being the fourth Layer released in the first generation of Burst products. Since this first wave of releases though, better options have appeared, such as [[Layer - Odin|Odin]]. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Kerbeus''' has become too light to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Kerbeus is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Lost Longinus'''|ロストロンギヌス|Rosuto Ronginusu}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-66 Starter, [[Lost Longinus Nine Spiral]], on December 28th, 2016.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A left-spin Attack Type Layer that can pierce the opponent with the lower blade of its spear and attack continuously with the middle blade of its wing. In addition, its upper dragon-blade made of metal material adds weight to the Layer's attacks.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Lost Longinus''' is a wide and heavy Layer designed for Attack that features two large dragon heads, representing the anime's rendition of this Layer's beast, a dragon, that come from the perimeter in towards the center and four wings, two of which are larger and make up the main contact points and two of which are smaller and make up secondary contact points, creating an aggressive, high recoil design. The contact points of the larger wings are molded in the shape of spear heads which are meant to represent this Layer's namesake, the Roman Soldier Longinus of Christian Mythology who stabbed Christ in the heart with a lance.

'''Lost Longinus''' has two main gimmicks:
The first are the dragon heads as they are made of metal. The inclusion of the metal made '''Lost Longinus''' one of the heaviest Layers in the game at the time of release. The second is the fact that this Layer is made to spin Left, opposite to every other Burst Beyblade before it.

The heavy weight of '''Lost Longinus''' generates high inertia and 
with the aggressive design, makes this Layer excel in Knock-Out and Burst Attack potential in Left-Spin vs. Left-Spin matches. However, the Left-Spinning nature of '''Lost Longinus''' means that it and a Right-Spin opponent's Layer will spin together like gears if they are of similar spin speed which heavily reduces recoil and rate of Bursts. However, the high recoil shape can still create strong Knock-Out potential in Opposite-Spin matches. Furthermore, it allows for some degree of Spin-Equalization, however not enough to be the primary focus for Combinations.

'''Lost Longinus''' features three teeth of medium-high length that are capable of withstanding the recoil this Layer produces, even against another Left-Spin opponent as the heavy weight further increases Burst Resistance as the Layer's higher inertia can better resist teeth skipping.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Attack Combinations==
'''Lost Longinus''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination '''Lost Longinus''' [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Hold|Hold]]/[[Driver - Destroy|Destroy]]. The heavy weight of [[Disc - 0|0]]/[[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 5|5]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Cross|Cross]]/[[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Bump|Bump]]/[[Frame - Vortex|Vortex]]/[[Frame - Meteor|Meteor]] further enhances '''Lost Longinus'''<nowiki/>' high inertia and the Layer's teeth and weight reduces the Burst risk associated with using heavy Discs while the aggressive movement speed of [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Hold|Hold]]/[[Driver - Destroy|Destroy]] compliments the Layer's Knock-Out Attack. When using [[Driver - Hold|Hold]]/[[Driver - Destroy|Destroy]] specifically, due to the soft launch needed control it, this Combination is able to give '''Lost Longinus''' the low rotational velocity needed to Burst the opponent, while the free-spinning plate of the [[Driver - Hold|Hold]]/[[Driver - Destroy|Destroy]] allows the Combination to potentially Out-Spin its opponent through Spin-Equalization and Life-After-Death in the event that a Burst is not achieved.

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Standard=
Takara Tomy's '''Lost Longinus'''<nowiki/>' heavy weight, aggressive design and strong Burst Resistance made the Layer an excellent part in Knock-Out Attack Combinations. Its weight prevented the Layer from being immediately outclassed by weight alone with the release of the subsequent SwitchStrike/God Layer System.

However, '''Lost Longinus''' was outclassed with the release of its successor [[Layer - Nightmare Longinus|Nightmare Longinus]], which has greater success in matches against both Opposite-Spin and Same-Spin opponents. Furthermore, Dual Layers are heavily outclassed by later releases in the current metagame.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Lost Longinus is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
|-|Limited=
Takara Tomy's '''Lost Longinus''' finds niche use in the format, due to its heavy weight and aggressive design. As such, it can be utilized in Knock-Out Attack Combinations. However, in most Combinations it is outclassed by [[Layer - Bloody Longinus|Bloody Longinus]].

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Lost Longinus is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.'''
|-|Classic=
Takara Tomy's '''Lost Longinus''' is not legal in the WBO's Burst Classic Format.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Lost Longinus is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
</tabber>

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the cow-headed monster, Minoboros. A right-spin Attack Type Layer that has huge horns and has a large rampage due to its biased center of gravity.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Minoboros''' is a six sided Layer designed for Attack. The center of the Layer features the head of a bull to match the namesake of the Layer; the Minotaur, a monster from Greek mythology. The face of the Minotaur and the four notches around the perimeter make up the primary points of contact. Most of the weight of '''Minoboros''' is spread in a anchor-like shape throughout the Layer and while this may imply that '''Minoboros''' is imbalanced, the effect is so minuscule it does not affect the performance.

Due to its aggressive shape, '''Minoboros''' works well in Attack Combinations and has relatively high Stamina for an Attack-oriented Layer. Furthermore, '''Minoboros''' features three tall teeth allowing the Layer to withstand its own recoil. Despite being overshadowed by [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] in Burst Attack and [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] in Knock-Out Attack, '''Minoboros''' is considered a decent choice for Attack Combinations that focus on Out-Spinning the opponent if a Burst or Knock-Out is not achieved due to its relatively high Stamina compared to other Attack-oriented Layers.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Minoboros''' was a decent choice for Attack Combinations at the time of release and was a consistent counter against the highly prevalent [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]]. However, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Minoboros''' has become too light to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Minoboros is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Balance Type Layer that can defeat its opponent with its continuously-striking lower blade, and aims for a burst with its upper-shaped blade.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Nova Neptune''', like its predecessor [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]], is a Balance Type Layer that has an overall round shape. Its design consists of six sloped wave-like blades; three of which are large and are made of clear plastic, and the other three are smaller and are made of colored plastic. Unlike [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]]; in which two sideways heads on either side are featured in the center, the center of '''Nova Neptune''' features two downward profile faces on either side; with one of them wearing a crown, representing the Layer's namesake; Neptune, the god of the sea in Roman Mythology. 

Unlike its predecessor [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]], '''Nova Neptune''' has some recoil due to the shape of its sloped blades. As such, it does not have as much Defense capabilities as [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]]. While it is decent in terms of Stamina, other Layers such as [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]] are better options. Furthermore, '''Nova Neptune''' also has sub-par Attack, making it outclassed and ill-suited for Attack Combinations as well. 

'''Nova Neptune'''<nowiki/>'s four teeth further aggravate this issue; three of which are short in length, and only the second-to-last tooth is medium in length. This creates a high Burst risk that can be greatly reduced through the use of Performance Tips with a strong spring such as [[Driver - Zephyr'|Zephyr']] or [[Driver - Destroy'|Destroy']]. Despite the release of these Performance Tips, due to '''Nova Neptune'''<nowiki/>'s weak performance, it is rendered outclassed by its predecessor [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]].</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Nova Neptune''' is directly outclassed by its predecessor, and its somewhat poor performance makes it ill-suited for most types of Combinations. However, with the release of Performance Tips with stronger springs, '''Nova Neptune'''<nowiki/>'s issue of weak teeth is solved to a degree. While it is too light to be competitive in the current metagame, it does have potential in the Burst Classic Format.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Nova Neptune is recommended for collection purposes only in the Burst Standard Format, but is a welcome addition in the Burst Classic Format.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Attack Type Layer that has an upper-shaped lower blade and thick wall-like upper blade that can strike the opponent with a powerful impact.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Obelisk Odin''', unlike its predecessor [[Layer - Odin|Odin]], is an Attack Type Layer that’s thick and angular in shape. Its design consists of a colored blade molded into the shape of a sword on either side, matching the weapon the Layer’s spirit wields; a large sword, two blades on either side that are made of both clear and colored plastic that run behind the sword-like blades, and two orb-like designs on either side that are also made of clear plastic and have a small protrusion on them. Surrounding the center of the Layer are two sideways armored heads on either side, with one of their eyes colored red, representing the Layer’s namesake; Odin, father of Thor in Norse mythology.

Unlike [[Layer - Odin|Odin]], '''Obelisk Odin'''’s more aggressive design greatly resembles the Samurai Upper Attack Ring from the [[Hard Metal System]] (HMS), which at its time, was a top-tier Attack Ring. While the resemblance may imply high Attack potential, in practice, '''Obelisk Odin'''’s overall shape ends up reducing some beneficial recoil. While this may imply that it is ill-suited for Attack Combinations, the aforementioned protrusions on the Layer’s orb-like designs imply high Burst Attack, as the protrusions can catch onto the protrusions of the opponent’s Layer and thus create enough recoil to Burst them. For Smash Attack, the blunt designs of the Layer’s sword-like blades can create enough recoil to potentially Knock-Out the opponent. However, while the Layer’s design does make it great for Attack Combinations, it is ill-suited for Defense and Stamina Combinations, as the recoil created by the Layer’s aggressive shape increases the risk of Bursting.

'''Obelisk Odin''' features three teeth of tall length, allowing it to withstand its own recoil. Furthermore, when paired up with rubber-based Drivers such as [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] or [[Driver - Jolt|Jolt]], the Layer's tall teeth can compensate for the Performance Tip's resistance to the Layer’s spin.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Attack Combinations==
If superior Layers such as [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]], [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]], [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]], or [[Layer - Minoboros (Takara Tomy)|Minoboros]] are unavailable, '''Obelisk Odin''' can be used in the Knock-Out Attack Combination '''Obelisk Odin''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]], which draws out what little Attack power '''Obelisk Odin''' has. A Knock-Out Combination is preferred, as '''Obelisk Odin''' performs miserably when stationary.

==Overall==
Despite its aggressive appearance, Takara Tomy's '''Obelisk Odin'''<nowiki/>'s mediocre performance made it become outclassed at the time of its release. Furthermore, with the release of Cho-Z Layers such as [[Layer - Winning Valkyrie|Winning Valkyrie]] and [[Layer - Buster Xcalibur|Buster Xcalibur]], '''Obelisk Odin''' is far too light to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Obelisk Odin is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Odin'''|オーディン|Ōdin}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-17 Booster, [[Odin Central Blow]], on October 17th, 2015.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the war god, Odin. A right-spin Attack Type Layer with an oval-shaped saw blade that can give a powerful attack.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Odin''' is an elliptical Layer that features three sloped blades on the longer sides and the center features a face on either side with only one eye colored red; meant to represent Odin, father of Thor in Norse mythology.

While elliptical shapes normally generate high recoil, the sloped blades act like those found on [[Layer - Wyvern|Wyvern]]; deflecting attacks and reducing recoil. Furthermore the elliptical shape concentrates this Layer's weight onto two sides creating a high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and Flywheel Effect, giving '''Odin''' comparable stamina to [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]]. '''Odin''' features three teeth of medium length allowing it to withstand most of the recoil that isn't deflected by the blades the elliptical shape produces. However, like other pre-Xcalibur Layers, '''Odin'''<nowiki/>'s teeth will wear down quickly with use, meaning that multiple copies must be purchased to replace ones that have worn down.

There are two mold variations of '''Odin''' that have been released. The second mold reinforces one side increasing the weight by 0.2 grams and making the Layer slightly off balanced. However this does little to affect performance.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Odin''' features high Stamina and Burst Resistance when launched weaker than the opponent and was once a top-tier Layer in the metagame to the point of being banned in tournament play. However, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Odin''' is now too light to remain competitive. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Odin is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-61 [[Random Booster Vol. 4 Quad Quetzalcoatl.J.P]] on October 22nd, 2016.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Defense Type Dual Layer that can deflect the opponent's attack with its feather-like shape that covers the outer circumference of its upper blade and counters attacks with its lower blade.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Quad Quetzalcoatl''' is a wide and thick Layer designed for Defense. The top of the Layer features a snake's head with its tongue flickering out, the center features a loop of molded scales like a coiled serpent, the bottom features a snake's tail tip and the perimeter is molded like the hook of a cobra or large wings, all meant to represent this Layer's namesake; the feathered serpent Quetzalcoatl, the Aztec god of wind and learning.

While '''Quad Quetzalcoatl''' may appear round at first glance, on closer inspection this Layer is actually tear drop shaped. The top and bottom of this drop are open to allow the serpent's head and tail tip to protrude in order to facilitate this Layer's gimmick, counter attack. In theory the large wings are to deflect attacks, the tail tip and serpent head are meant to create points of recoil in order to Burst the opponent. While this gimmick creates a design akin to [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]], in practice it almost always hinders '''Quad Quetzalcoatl'''<nowiki/>'s performance. The tear drop shape of the wings is unable to deflect attacks as well as a round shape and the snake head and tail tip do not protrude far enough to create the desired Burst Attack, instead slowing a '''Quad Quetzalcoatl'''-based Combination down and while '''Quad Quetzalcoatl''' does have four teeth of medium-high length, the Burst Resistance is reduced by the recoil of the counter attack gimmick and does not compensate for the poor Stamina.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Quad Quetzalcoatl''' does have decent Burst Resistance, the recoil of the counter attack gimmick severely reduces the Stamina of this Layer. Furthermore, while it has a similar shape to [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]], the tail tip does not protrude as far as [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]]'s sword tip, making '''Quad Quetzalcoatl''' unsuitable for Attack Combinations either. Finally, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Quad Quetzalcoatl''' is comparatively too light.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Quad Quetzalcoatl is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Ragnaruk'''|ラグナルク|Ragunaruku}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-03 Starter, [[Ragnaruk Heavy Survive]], on July 18th, 2015.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of a devil that wears the flames of the end, Ragnaruk. A right-spin Stamina Type Layer with a large diameter and a shape that is close to a circle that demonstrates endurance and keeps the Beyblade spinning for a long time.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Ragnaruk''' is a rugged looking Layer that bears a striking resemblance to [[Seaborg]]'s [[Attack Ring - Whale Attacker|Whale Attacker]], featuring two flat, blunt protrusions with smaller, pointier trailing edges. Unlike most other Layers that incorporate some sort of slope or relief, '''Ragnaruk''' has a nearly-uniform thickness throughout the Layer. The majority of '''Ragnaruk'''<nowiki/>'s weight is packed behind its two primary contact points, which, coupled with the shape of these protrusions, provide the Layer with a considerable amount of Burst Attack. However, these same features also subject '''Ragnaruk''' to large amounts of rotational recoil during a collision as well. As '''Ragnaruk''' has only three average sized teeth and one small tooth, it is unable to handle its own recoil and tends to Burst quite often, making it practically nonviable in competitive play.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Burst Attack Combinations==
Though outclassed by [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]], '''Ragnaruk''' can be used in the Burst Attack Combination '''Ragnaruk''' [[Disc - Armed|Armed]] [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]]. This combo combines '''Ragnaruk'''<nowiki/>'s moderate Burst Attack with [[Disc - Armed|Armed]]'s ability to reduce the chance of the combo Self-Bursting. While inconsistent at best, it can be used to defeat Stationary Combinations with particularly poor Burst Defense such as [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]] [[Driver - Revolve|Revolve]].

==Overall==
Despite its potential in Attack Combinations, Takara Tomy's '''Ragnaruk''' suffers from having poor Burst Resistance, resulting in a number of Self-Bursts when attacking. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Ragnaruk is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Rising Ragnaruk'''|ライジングラグナルク|Raijingu Ragunaruku}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-36 Booster, [[Rising Ragnaruk Gravity Revolve]], on April 2nd, 2016.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of a devil that wears the flames of the end, Ragnaruk. A right-spin Stamina Type Dual Layer that creates a large centrifugal force and airflow with its two upper blades that undulate like a flame while attacking its opponent with a lower attack.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Rising Ragnaruk''' is a Stamina Type Layer that features an elliptical shape akin to its predecessor [[Layer - Ragnaruk|Ragnaruk]]. Like its predecessor, the Layer's wings are molded into the visage of a head on either side, matching the anime's rendition of the Layer's beast; a winged demon. The placement of these wings is where the majority of the Layer's weight is, creating a high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and Flywheel Effect which bolsters '''Rising Ragnaruk'''<nowiki/>'s Stamina. While this may imply high Stamina potential, these wings also make up the primary points of contact, creating a recoil heavy design that severely diminishes the Stamina benefits of its Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and Flywheel Effect. While the high recoil of the elliptical shape and the wings may imply high Attack potential, '''Rising Ragnaruk''' features weak teeth that are unable to withstand the aforementioned recoil, meaning that this Layer is prone to losses by Burst.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Rising Ragnaruk''' is plagued with a recoil heavy design and low Burst Resistance, causing it to Burst far too easily in battle. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Rising Ragnaruk is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}'''Roktavor''' is a [[Layer]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in western countries with the release of the [[Roktavor and Nepstrius Dual Pack]].

==Description==
<onlyinclude>In-depth information for Hasbro’s '''Roktavor''' Layer will be placed here once drafting has been completed for it. Please be patient.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Knock-Out Attack Combinations==
'''Roktavor''' can be put to use on the Knock-Out Attack Combination '''Roktavor''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]]/[[Disc - Down|Down]] [[Driver - Variable|Variable]]/[[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]. Although [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] and [[Driver - Variable|Variable]] are preferred for Layers excelling in Knock-Out Attack like [[Layer - Xcalius|Xcalius]], their high speed can provide powerful hits which combined with the aggressive shape of '''Roktavor''' can Burst the opponent. The high speed of [[Driver - Variable|Variable]]/[[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] also increase the chances of a Knock-Out. While using a heavier Disc might provide powerful hits, using a lighter Disc can reduce the risks of Self-Bursting.

==Use in Mixed Attack Combinations==
'''Roktavor''' can be used in the Mixed Attack Combination '''Roktavor''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]]/[[Disc - Down|Down]] [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]. Although this combo may not possess the same Knock-Out potential and high speed as [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Variable|Variable]] variants, it is easier to control and the higher Stamina of [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] provides more hits, increasing the chances of a Burst or Out-Spin if it fails to Knock-Out the opponent.

==Use in Stationary Attack Combinations==
Due to having excellent Burst Attack because of its aggressive shape, '''Roktavor''' can be used on the Stationary Attack Combination '''Roktavor''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Down|Down]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] [[Driver - Survive|Survive]]/[[Driver - Press|Press]]/[[Driver - Defense|Defense]]/[[Driver - Needle|Needle]]. This combo can Burst opponents as consistently as [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]/[[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Variable|Variable]] variants while having lower chances of a Self-Knock-Out than [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]/[[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]/[[Driver - Variable|Variable]] variants. In addition to this, the aggressive shape of '''Roktavor''' can Burst other Attack-oriented Layers on Mobile or Stationary Combinations.

==Overall==
Like all other Hasbro Layers, Hasbro's '''Roktavor''' is made of a softer plastic that causes it to have lower Stamina than Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Ragnaruk|Ragnaruk]]. However, despite this, the steep slopes of '''Roktavor''' make it much less likely to Burst than its Takara Tomy counterpart, meaning that it can take full advantage of its aggressive shape to exhibit excellent performance in Burst Attack while also having moderate Knock-Out Attack. Due to its steep slopes and aggressive shape, '''Roktavor''' can be used in Attack Combinations with success.

Hasbro's '''Roktavor''' was a top-tier and commonly available Layer for Attack Combinations. However, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, specifically [[Layer - Legend Spryzen S3|Legend Spryzen S3]], '''Roktavor''' has become outclassed. 

'''As such, Hasbro's Roktavor is not a must have but is instead a welcome addition to a blader's collection.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Spriggan'''|スプリガン|Supurigan}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-02 DX Starter, [[Spriggan Spread Fusion]], on July 18th, 2015.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the treasure protecting giant, Spriggan. A right-spin Balance Type Layer that has both an aggressive shape and a defensive aspect.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Spriggan''' features three prominent bumps on each side of it, two of them getting their shape from the double claw-like design created by the colored plastic underneath the transparent casing. This means that its weight is mostly focused in the center and in a sort of pendulum with two arms spread out, generating some Flywheel Effect. However, its overall weight is among the lowest in all Layers, below the average of 8.0 grams.

The teeth underneath its core are in ascending order, the third one being the tallest, with a very small fourth tooth at the end. This implies that the harder it gets hit, the harder it is to Burst, unless the third tooth is forcibly skipped over.

This Layer is a "jack of all trades, master of none": while it isn't top-tier in any format and was always second to [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] upon release, it delivers surprisingly strong hits against Combinations that are usually solid. It can be effective whether it is on a Mobile Combination on a Performance Tip like [[Driver - Accel|Accel]], or a mostly Stationary Combination in the middle of the stadium on Performance Tips like [[Driver - Defense|Defense]] or [[Driver - Survive|Survive]]. However, its use is risky and fades away in comparison to more reliable top-tier Combinations. In other words, while it has its lucky moments, '''Spriggan''' is unable to deliver a consistent performance, unlike Layers that are much more aggressive like [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]], [[Layer - Amaterios|Amaterios]] and [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]].</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Spriggan''' is able to produce powerful hits on rare occasions, it is outclassed both by [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] and the far more versatile [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] in Attack Combinations even when paired with the top-tier [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]], and has shown no potential in other types of Combinations. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Spriggan''' is too light to be competitive. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Spriggan is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

Storm Spryzen |ProductCode=B9488 |Classification=Layer |Type=Balance |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=7.4 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}'''Storm Spryzen S2''' is a [[Layer]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Burst System]] and the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in western countries with the release of the Starter Pack, [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]]. ==Description== In-depth information for Hasbro’s '''Storm Spryzen S2''' Layer will be placed here once drafting has been completed for it. Please be patient. ==Overall== Like all other Hasbro Layers, Hasbro's '''Storm Spryzen S2''' is made of a softer plastic that causes it to have lower Stamina than Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Storm Spriggan|Storm Spriggan]]. However, despite this, the steep slopes of '''Storm Spryzen S2''' make it much less likely to Burst than its Takara Tomy counterpart, meaning that it can take full advantage of its aggressive, elliptical shape to exhibit excellent performance in Knock-Out Attack while also having moderate Burst Attack. While '''Storm Spryzen S2''' can be used on Stationary Burst Attack Combinations such as '''Storm Spryzen S2''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Armed|Armed]] [[Driver - Survive|Survive]] or rubber-tipped Knock-Out Attack Combinations like '''Spryzen S2''' [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]] [[Driver - Variable|Variable]]/[[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] with some success, it is outclassed by [[Layer - Roktavor|Roktavor]] and [[Layer - Valtryek|Valtryek]] for Burst Attack and [[Layer - Xcalius|Xcalius]], [[Layer - Lost Luinor L2|Lost Lúinor L2]], and [[Layer - Victory Valtryek V2|Victory Valtryek V2]] for Knock-Out Attack. However, due to '''Storm Spryzen S2''''s relative proficiency in both types of Attack, it shines in a Mixed Attack Combination, outperforming [[Layer - Valtryek|Valtryek]] and [[Layer - Beast Betromoth B2|Beast Betromoth B2]] in similar Combinations.  ==Use in Mixed Attack Combinations== '''Storm Spryzen S2''' can be best put to use in the Mixed Attack Combination '''Storm Spryzen S2''' [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]] [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]. While this Combination may not possess the same Knock-Out potential as variants using [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] or [[Driver - Variable|Variable]], it is easier to control and can be launched at a higher RPM with significantly less risk of Self-Bursts or Self-Knock-Outs. In addition, the higher Stamina and lower friction of [[Driver - Accel|Accel]] and [[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] give this Combination more opportunities to Burst its opponent with high RPM hits. As with all Hasbro combos, it is recommended to prioritize using a Forge Disc that causes the combo to fit tightly together over normally recommended Forge Discs. ==Products== ===Hasbro=== * B9488 [[Storm Spryzen S2 Knuckle Unite]] * B9498 [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]] - [[Storm Spryzen S2 Knuckle Unite]] * C1514 [[Storm Spryzen S2 Rip Fire Pack]] - [[Storm Spryzen S2 Knuckle-L Unite-L]] * E1048 [[Storm Spryzen S2 Limited Variable]] * F3343 [[Evolution Trio Spryzen 3-Pack]] - [[Storm Spryzen S2 Knuckle Unite]] ==Gallery== ===Hasbro=== LayerStormSpryzenS2.png|Storm Spryzen S2 (B9498) Storm Spryzen S2 (B9488).png|Storm Spryzen S2 (B9488) Storm Spryzen S2 (E1048).png|Storm Spryzen S2 (E1048) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Hasbro]]

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the three-pronged spear, Trident. A large right-spin Stamina Type Layer with three large blades that can create a centrifugal force.
|speaker = Official Description}}
As the name implies, Takara Tomy's '''Trident''' is based on the iconic three-pronged spear belonging to the Roman god Neptune. '''Trident''' is a Layer that overall has a triangular shape, with a trident-shaped protrusion transcending two of these sides. At the corners of this triangle, there are two arrow heads pointing toward each other. 

As '''Trident''' is a wide Layer, its weight is spread too far out, which causes imbalance and quickly deteriorates Stamina in battle. Furthermore, due to the placement and flat design of the protrusions, '''Trident''' lacks both the power to Destabilize the opponent and the design to defend itself, limiting its competitive use.

'''Trident''' also has small, shallow teeth, similar to [[Layer - Ragnaruk|Ragnaruk]]'s, which makes this Layer susceptible to Bursting.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Trident'''<nowiki/>'s wider design makes it unique, it suffers from having a bad weight distribution, sub-par design and weak teeth. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Trident is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of a Unicorn. A right-spin Defense Type Layer in which the horn and mane are placed on the outer circumference to create a wall with its ten blades and to attack the opponent.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Unicorn''' is primarily a circular Layer, featuring ten small protrusions that point counter-clockwise. Eight of these protrusions make up the “manes” of the two unicorns depicted in the layer, leaving the other two as the “horns”. Because of its relatively large diameter and Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), '''Unicorn''' has Stamina capabilities rivaling those of [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]]. However, these traits also work against it by increasing the rotational recoil the Layer takes during collisions – as '''Unicorn'''’s teeth are shorter than average, it is relatively easy to Burst despite its unaggressive shape. Because of its tendency to Burst, '''Unicorn''' is directly outclassed by [[Layer - Neptune|Neptune]], which has a similar amount of Stamina while also offering a higher amount of Burst Defense.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Unicorn''' has excellent Stamina, it Bursts too easily to warrant use in a competitive situation and with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Unicorn''' is now too light to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Unicorn is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
<onlyinclude>In-depth information for Hasbro’s '''Unicrest''' Layer will be placed here once drafting has been completed for it. Please be patient.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Hasbro's '''Unicrest''' is identical in shape to Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Unicorn|Unicorn]], it has been slightly altered, causing it to perform differently than its Takara Tomy counterpart. The most notable change is one that affects all of Hasbro’s Burst System releases: the use of a slope on the underside of the Layer to manage the Burst Mechanic rather than teeth. '''Unicrest'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s relatively steep slope means that it experiences a significant increase in Burst Defense compared to [[Layer - Unicorn|Unicorn]], which made it a once top-tier Layer for Defense Combinations, however, due to the lighter materials used by Hasbro and the additional plastic added to the center of the Layer, its Stamina has been lowered to create only average spin times. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, specifically [[Layer - Drain Fafnir F3|Drain Fafnir F3]] and [[Layer - Legend Spryzen S3|Legend Spryzen S3]], '''Unicrest''' has become too light to remain competitive.

'''As such, Hasbro's Unicrest is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Defense Type Layer that can disperse the opponent's attack with its nine blades and can counter with the corners of its upper blade.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Unlock Unicorn''' is a round Layer designed for Defense that features ten blades, nine of which are made up of clear plastic and make the "mane" and one which is made of colored plastic and makes "the horn" of this Layer's namesake; the mythical Unicorn, featured in the center.

The clear blades of the "mane" are smooth, compact and placed in a manner that deflects oncoming attacks, creating a low recoil design, while the single "horn" is shaped differently to create this Layer's gimmick; counter attack. Since the horn is much thinner and rests at a much higher angle than the rest of the blades, it creates a sizable gap that is, in theory, meant to provide Smash Attack to Burst the opponent and/or drain their Stamina. However, in practice, the angle and direction of the horn is ill-suited for such a purpose and instead creates a point of recoil, that is more recoil heavy when off balance, that drains '''Unlock Unicorn'''<nowiki/>'s Stamina.

This problem is further exacerbated by its teeth, which are very short and weak. While they can withstand the low recoil provided by the mane, the recoil provided by the gap makes '''Unlock Unicorn''' very prone to Bursts.

While the weight distribution of '''Unlock Unicorn''' does lend itself well to Stamina purposes, this does little to compensate for the recoil and teeth issues.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Unlock Unicorn''' does have some capabilities for Stamina, it is still outclassed by other Layers such as [[Layer - Deathscyther|Deathscyther]] and [[Layer - Dark Deathscyther|Dark Deathscyther]], plus the recoil of the self-destructive counter attack gimmick and weak teeth render this Layer outclassed for competitive use.

|quote = The motif is of the goddess of battle, Valkyrie. A right-spin Attack Type Layer that bursts the opponent by launching a powerful attack with its three large blades.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Valkyrie''' features a three-winged design, with each wing sporting a set of two protruding contact points. These consist of a larger contact point and a smaller kite-shaped contact point. The centre of the Layer depicts an armored face, with feathers protruding off of the helmet, and a V-shape between them to represent this Layer's namesake: [[wikipedia:Valkyrie|valkyries]], Odin's handmaidens in Norse mythology.

Due to its aggressive shape and the angles of the points of contact, '''Valkyrie''' was one of the best Layers for Attack combinations, excelling in both Burst and Knockout (KO) Attack. '''Valkyrie''' features four Locks (teeth) of tall length which allow it to withstand its own recoil, however, like other pre-Xcalibur Layers, the teeth of '''Valkyrie''' quickly wear down with use and the Layer must be replaced after heavy use.

At its release, Takara Tomy's '''Valkyrie''' was one of the best Layers for Attack combinations and remained as the best Attack Layer until the release of [[Layer - Lost Longinus|Lost Longinus]] and the [[God Layer System]], where '''Valkyrie''' then became too light to remain competitive.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Attack Combinations==
'''Valkyrie''' can be put to use in the Attack combination '''Valkyrie''' [[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] [[Driver - Xtreme'|Xtreme']]. '''Valkyrie'''<nowiki/>'s strong Burst and Knockout Attack potential is bolstered by Gravity's weight and the speed of Xtreme', while Gravity's greater Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) increases the speed of Xtreme'. '''Valkyrie'''<nowiki/>'s unworn teeth are capable of withstanding the increased Burst risk of heavy Discs and high friction Drivers.

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Burst=
Single Layers such as Takara Tomy's '''Valkyrie''' are outclassed in the format by much heavier Dynamite Battle Layers.

'''As such, Valkyrie is not recommended for the WBO's Burst format.'''
|-|Burst GT=
Single Layers such as Takara Tomy's '''Valkyrie''' are outclassed in the format by much heavier Gatinko Layers.

'''As such, Valkyrie is not recommended for the WBO's Burst GT format.'''
|-|Burst Limited=
Single Layers such as Takara Tomy's '''Valkyrie''' are outclassed in the format by heavier Layers.

'''As such, Valkyrie is not recommended for the WBO's Burst Limited format.'''
|-|Burst Classic=
As was the case during its peak, '''Valkyrie''' is an excellent Layer choice for Attack combinations. It can be used with rubber Attack Drivers such as Xtreme' to create combinations with excellent Burst and Knockout (KO) Attack potential.

'''As such, Valkyrie is a must-have for the WBO's Burst Classic format.'''
</tabber>

}}'''Valtryek''' is a [[Layer]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in western countries with the release of the [[Valtryek and Unicrest Dual Pack]].

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Hasbro's '''Valtryek''' is a right-spin Attack Type Layer based on Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]]. It is virtually identical to its Takara Tomy counterpart, featuring the same three-winged design, with each wing sporting a set of two protruding contact points. These consist of a larger contact point and a smaller kite-shaped contact point. The centre of the Layer depicts an armored face, with feathers protruding off of the helmet, and a V-shape between them to represent this Layer's namesake: [[wikipedia:Valkyrie|valkyries]], Odin's handmaidens in Norse mythology.

Compared to Takara Tomy's Valkyrie, the slopes of '''Valtryek''' are weaker than a mint Valkyrie's teeth, with performance comparable to a moderately worn Valkyrie. Due to its weak Burst Resistance, it cannot handle its recoil as well as a mint Valkyrie, which can also further increase its Burst Resistance with Dash Drivers. This is further exacerbated by the low Burst Resistance of Hasbro's rubber Attack Drivers. As such, '''Valtryek''' is outclassed by Takara Tomy's Valkyrie, but comparable to other Hasbro Attack Layer options such as [[Layer - Roktavor|Roktavor]] and [[Layer - Xcalius|Xcalius]].</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Burst=
Single Layers such as Hasbro's '''Valtryek''' are outclassed in the format by much heavier Dynamite Battle Layers.

'''As such, Valtryek is not recommended for the WBO's Burst format.'''
|-|Burst GT=
Single Layers such as Hasbro's '''Valtryek''' are outclassed in the format by much heavier Gatinko Layers.

'''As such, Valtryek is not recommended for the WBO's Burst GT format.'''
|-|Burst Limited=
Single Layers such as Hasbro's '''Valtryek''' are outclassed in the format by heavier Layers.

'''As such, Valtryek is not recommended for the WBO's Burst Limited format.'''
|-|Burst Classic=
Although Hasbro's '''Valtryek''' retains the same shape as its Takara Tomy counterpart, it cannot handle its recoil due to its own low Burst Resistance and that of Hasbro's Attack Driver options.

'''As such, Valtryek is not recommended for the WBO's Burst Classic format.'''
</tabber>

}}{{Translation|'''Victory Valkyrie'''|ビクトリーヴァルキリー|Bikutorī Varukirī}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] and the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan in the B-34 Starter, [[Victory Valkyrie Boost Variable]], on April 2nd, 2016.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the goddess of battle, Valkyrie. A right-spin Attack Type Dual Layer that can break its opponent's balance with a lower attack with its wings and aims for a burst with an intense upper attack with its big sword.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Like its predecessor [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]], Takara Tomy's '''Victory Valkyrie''' has three upward slanted wings that excel at Knockout (KO) Attack but the Layer falls behind its predecessor [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] at giving Bursts. Unlike [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]]'s teeth, the teeth of '''Victory Valkyrie''' have no problem with wear due to them having greater width, following the model introduced with [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]]. The teeth are also very tall which allows the Layer to withstand its own recoil and avoid Self-Bursts which made this Layer an excellent choice for Attack Combinations.

There are three minor mold variations of '''Victory Valkyrie''': the first mold has completely hollow wings which make it very fragile and prone to breaking. The second mold, introduced with the Kirin Limited Campaign Green Ver. release, has added bars within the wings for reinforcement. However, despite these reinforcements, this Layer continued to suffer cases of breaks. This led to a third mold, first introduced in Asian releases of the B-57 [[Triple Booster Set]] and Japanese releases of the B-64 [[Beyblade Super Custom Set Heavy Ver.]]. This mold includes a reinforced center ring along with the aforementioned bars within the wings, which not only addresses most of the breakage issues but also causes the part to weigh about half a gram more than its first mold variation. It is advised for Bladers to find a third generation mold because of this increased weight and durability, though the first and second versions will suffice if one is prepared to replace them.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
With Takara Tomy's '''Victory Valkyrie'''<nowiki/>'s strong teeth and aggressive shape, this Layer is a top-tier part for Attack Combinations in the Burst Classic Format and made a great alternative to [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]] and [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] if they were not available. However, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Victory Valkyrie''' is simply too light to remain competitive in the current metagame.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Victory Valkyrie is a must have for competitive bladers of the Burst Classic Format but is recommended for collection purposes otherwise.'''

Victory Valtryek |ProductCode=B9487 |Classification=Layer |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=8.6 grams |System=Dual Layer System |Series=Beyblade Burst |ReleaseUS=December 2016 |ReleaseCA=September 2016 |BurstStandard=✔️ |BurstGT=✔️ |BurstLimited=✔️ |BurstClassic=✔️ }}'''Victory Valtryek V2''' is a [[Layer]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Burst System]] and the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in western countries with the release of the [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]]. ==Description== In-depth information for Hasbro’s '''Victory Valtryek V2''' Layer will be placed here once drafting has been completed for it. Please be patient. ==Overall== Hasbro's '''Victory Valtryek V2''' has two primary differences. The first is that the three wings are shaped somewhat differently. Unlike Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]], where the contact points of the wings are straight at an obtuse angle, the wings of '''Victory Valtryek V2''' curve inwards to create a hook like shape and the angle is steeper. This change in shape means '''Victory Valtryek V2''' enjoys an increase in Burst Attack, as the point of contact is more likely to catch the protrusions of opposing Layers. The second is the plastic used. While '''Victory Valtryek V2''' has completely hollow wings like the first mold of its Takara Tomy counterpart, it features the center reinforcement ring of the third mold of its Takara Tomy counterpart, and the plastic used is softer, making it much more durable. Overall, the well shaped contact points of '''Victory Valtryek V2''' make it a top-tier Layer for Attack Combinations in the Burst Classic Format if Layers such as [[Layer - Roktavor|Roktavor]] are unavailable. However, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Victory Valtryek V2''' has become too light to remain competitive in the current metagame. '''As such, Hasbro's Victory Valtryek V2 is a must have for competitive bladers of the Burst Classic Format but is recommended for collection purposes otherwise.''' ==Products== ===Hasbro=== * B9487 [[Victory Valtryek V2 Boost Variable]] * B9498 [[Epic Rivals Battle Set]] - [[Victory Valtryek V2 Boost Variable]] * C0706 [[Avatar Attack Battle Set]] - [[Victory Valtryek V2 Boost Variable]] * C1513 [[Victory Valtryek V2 Rip Fire Pack]] - [[Victory Valtryek V2 Boost-L Variable-L]] * C3401 [[Apex Attack Pack]] - [[Victory Valtryek V2 Boost Variable]] * E1046 [[Victory Valtryek V2 Limited Unite]] * F3342 [[Evolution Trio Valtryek 3-Pack]] - [[Victory Valtryek V2 Boost Variable]] ==Gallery== ===Hasbro=== LayerVictoryValtryekV2.png|Victory Valtryek V2 (B9498) Victory Valtryek V2 (B9487).png|Victory Valtryek V2 (B9487) Victory Valtryek V2 (C0706).png|Victory Valtryek V2 (C0706) Victory Valtryek V2 (C3401).png|Victory Valtryek V2 (C3401) Victory Valtryek V2 (E1046).png|Victory Valtryek V2 (E1046) ==Trivia== * The red variant of '''Victory Valtryek V2''' that appears in the [[Apex Attack Pack]] has printed details that look similar to the B-49 variant of [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]]. * The black variant of '''Victory Valtryek V2''' that appears in the [[Victory Valtryek V2 Limited Unite]] Single Pack has a more translucent mold of soft plastic, and has a color scheme that appears as a mix between that of the B-00 Special Limited and B-49 Random Booster Vol. 3 variant of [[Layer - Victory Valkyrie|Victory Valkyrie]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Burst System Parts}} [[Category:Hasbro]]

}}{{Translation|'''Wild Wyvern'''|ワイルドワイバーン|Wairudo Waibān}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] and the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the B-41 Booster, [[Wild Wyvern Vertical Orbit]], on April 29th, 2016.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the flying dragon, Wyvern. A right-spin Defense Type Dual Layer that keeps opponents away without the need of repeated hits with its four small blades in the upper row and four large blades in the lower row.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Wild Wyvern''' is a Defense Type Layer that features eight blades that alternate between colored and clear plastic and the head of a dragon, meant to represent this Layer's namesake; the Wyvern, a two-legged winged dragon.

While '''Wild Wyvern''' may seem round and thus ideal for Defense at first glance, upon closer inspection it's actually square in shape. Each of the corners of this square shape create points of recoil that make it unsuitable for Defense Combinations. This problem is further exacerbated for '''Wild Wyvern''', which has teeth akin to that of [[Layer - Chaos|Chaos]], which leads to the downfall of this Layer. The teeth are so short that they are unable to withstand the recoil that comes from the square shape, making '''Wild Wyvern''' severely prone to losses by Burst.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Wild Wyvern''' suffers from both a recoil producing shape and incredibly weak teeth, causing it to Burst far too easily in battle. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Wild Wyvern''' is comparatively too light. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Wild Wyvern is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Wolborg''' is a [[Burst System]] adaptation of the [[Attack Ring - Reverse Wolf|Reverse Wolf]] Attack Ring and [[Bit Chip - Wolborg|Wolborg]] Bit Chip from the [[Original Series]]' [[Spin Gear System]]. As such it features an overall square/diamond shape with four wolf heads that act as the main contact points and an image of the Bit Beast Wolborg in the center. The only differences between this Layer and the original Attack Ring are that the wolf heads are more rounded, lack the gap in the blades, and are more compact, making the Layer somewhat smaller overall. The "Bit Chip" is non-removable.

'''Wolborg''' features three teeth of tall length. However, two factors leads to the downfall of this Layer despite its teeth; the Layer's shape and its weight. Furthermore, like other Original Series Layer adaptations, '''Wolborg''' is made from only a single layer of plastic and is very hollow which creates a light weight. Such weight generates little inertia, making this Layer very prone to Bursts.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Due to the shape and light weight of Takara Tomy's '''Wolborg''', this Layer Self-Bursts too easily and thus outclassed by other Layers.

}}{{Translation|'''Wyvern'''|ワイバーン|Waibān}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-14 Starter, [[Wyvern Armed Massive]], on September 19th, 2015.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the flying dragon, Wyvern. A right-spin Defense Type Layer with seven blades that are used to burst an opponent and parry attacks.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Wyvern''' is a circular, seven-bladed Layer. The center of the Layer features the head of a dragon to represent this Layer's namesake; a two legged, winged dragon, the Wyvern.

While the spiked design may imply that this Layer has a lot of recoil, the direction of the blades means that they would parry the oncoming hits which reduces recoil. When the opponent's Layer comes into contact with '''Wyvern''', there are two likely outcomes. The opposing Layer hits the outside of '''Wyvern'''’s blade, resulting in minimal impact, or the opposing layer hits the empty space between '''Wyvern'''’s spikes, causing the opposing Layer to be pushed away. This gives this Layer high Defense potential. Most of the weight of this Layer is focused around the perimeter which combined with its circular shape gives it excellent Stamina properties as well.

'''Wyvern''' features four teeth of short length, while this may imply poor Burst Resistance, the circular shape of '''Wyvern''' produces such little recoil that it can be withstood by its teeth, creating a Layer with high Burst Resistance. However, like other pre-Xcalibur Layers, the teeth of '''Wyvern''' wear out fairly quickly and thus multiple copies must be purchased in order to replace ones that have worn down.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Wyvern''' was once one of the best Layers for Stamina/Defense Combinations, but with the release of SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Wyvern''' has become too light to remain competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Wyvern is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
