}}{{Translation|'''Xcalibur'''|エクスカリバー|Ekusukaribā}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-23 Starter, [[Xcalibur Force Xtreme]], on December 26th, 2015.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the holy sword, Xcalibur. A right-spin Attack Type Layer that gives a super powerful blow to its opponent with its big sword.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Xcalibur''' is an Attack Type Layer based on the legendary sword Excalibur and features a large sword running down the length of the Layer, two bird heads along the sides and a large "X" in the center. This Layer contains one primary contact point, the tip of the sword which protrudes significantly from the bottom which makes this Layer excel at giving both Knock-Outs and Bursts. '''Xcalibur''' was the first Layer to have redesigned teeth in that they were made much wider to fix a problem with wear, said teeth are also very tall which allows the Layer to withstand its own recoil and avoid Self-Bursts. However, '''Xcalibur'''<nowiki/>'s design makes it incredibly imbalanced which worsens its stamina and can break Banking Patterns.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Attack Combinations==
'''Xcalibur''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination '''Xcalibur''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]]. '''Xcalibur''' works best when paired with a quick and aggressive Performance Tip like [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] and the heavy weight of [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] adds to the Combination's momentum and striking power. Furthermore, the high friction of [[Driver - Xtreme|Xtreme]] resists Banking Pattern loss from '''Xcalibur'''<nowiki/>'s off balanced design.

==Overall==
Because of its strong teeth and aggressive shape, Takara Tomy's '''Xcalibur''' had become top-tier for Attack Combinations. Unlike other top-tier Attack Layers like [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]], the redesigned teeth will not wear down with use. However, '''Xcalibur''' incurs Self-Bursts much more easily than [[Layer - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]], the off balanced design reduces stamina and is liable to breaking banking patterns. Furthermore, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Xcalibur''' is too light to stay competitive. 

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Xcalibur is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = A right-spin Attack Type Layer with three sections; one that can receive the opponent's attack with its lower blade, repel it with its middle blade, and cut through the opponent with its upper blade.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Xeno Xcalibur''', like its predecessor [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]], is an Attack Type Layer that features a large sword running down the length of the Layer, the end of which protrudes from the bottom and acts as the primary contact point making this Layer excel at both Knock-Out and Burst Attack. '''Xeno Xcalibur''' also features tall teeth which allows the Layer to withstand its own recoil. However, due to the exaggerated designs around the sword, '''Xeno Xcalibur'''<nowiki/>'s contact point doesn't protrude as far as [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]]'s, meaning that the Layer is outclassed by its predecessor, if only slightly. The contact point has a notable interaction with the [[Disc - Magnum|Magnum]], [[Disc - 1|1]], and [[Disc - 1'|1']] Discs: after two clicks, the contact point will line up with the sword protrusions of the Discs.

Due to the design of the sword, the Layer, like its predecessor, is imbalanced towards the sword point to increase Burst potential. However this drains Stamina and is liable to break banking patterns depending on the Tip used.

There are two mold variations of '''Xeno Xcalibur''': the first mold is fragile with common occurrences of both the handle and the blade of the sword breaking. The second mold features a reinforced handle and was first released in [[Random Booster Vol. 5 Gigant Gaia.Q.F]]. Reprints of the B-48 Starter that were manufactured in 2017 onward also have the second mold. Due to the fragile nature of the first mold, it is advised for Bladers to buy the second mold for use.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
While Takara Tomy's '''Xeno Xcalibur''' is somewhat outclassed its predecessor, it still has comparable Attack power and strong teeth and made a great alternative if [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]] is not available. However, with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Xeno Xcalibur''' is too light to be competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Xeno Xcalibur is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Yaeger Yggdrasil''' is a kite-shaped Stamina Type Layer similar to its predecessor [[Layer - Yggdrasil|Yggdrasil]]. It is named after Yggdrasil, the tree of life in Norse mythology, however to represent the anime’s rendition of this Layer’s beast, two dragon heads are present on either side near the center of the Layer.

Most of the weight of '''Yaeger Yggdrasil''' is focused on its perimeter. The recoil produced by the kite-like shape is too low to be useful for Attack Combinations. Further more, '''Yaeger Yggdrasil''' features four teeth of short length which are unable to handle its recoil making it extremely prone to Bursting. Due to these reasons, '''Yaeger Yggdrasil''' has no competitive usage in any type of Combination.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Yaeger Yggdrasil''' has too much recoil for its short teeth to compensate for, making it outclassed for competitive use.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>Hasbro's '''Yegdrion''' is a Stamina Type Layer based on Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Yggdrasil|Yggdrasil]]. As such, it has the same square shape, with two dragon heads and two sloped blades meant to represent dragon claws. The blades make up the primary points of contact of this Layer. Most of the weight of '''Yegdrion''' is focused on its perimeter, creating superb Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and high Stamina potential.

While its Takara Tomy counterpart suffered from weak Burst Resistance due to its four short teeth, '''Yegdrion''' has moderate slopes, giving it greater Burst Resistance and the ability to withstand its own recoil.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Standard=
Hasbro's '''Yegdrion''' is too light to be competitive in the current metagame.

'''As such, Hasbro's Yegdrion is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
|-|Limited=
Despite its high Stamina potential, Hasbro's '''Yegdrion''' is too light to compete with other Layers in the format that are heavier.

'''As such, Hasbro's Yegdrion is recommended for collection purposes only.'''
|-|Classic=
Hasbro's '''Yegdrion''' features moderate slopes, giving it higher Burst Resistance than Takara Tomy's [[Layer - Yggdrasil|Yggdrasil]] and allowing the Layer to withstand its own recoil. However the slopes are weaker than those of Layers like [[Layer - Kerbeus (Hasbro)|Kerbeus]], [[Layer - Atlas Anubion A2|Atlas Anubion A2]] and [[Layer - Jumbo Jormuntor J2|Jumbo Jormuntor J2]] making it lag behind these Layers in terms of Burst Defense. The high Flywheel Effect produced by its Outward Weight Distribution makes it one of the best Layers available for Stamina Combinations in the format.

'''As such, Hasbro's Yegdrion is a must have for competitive bladers.'''
</tabber>

==Use in Stamina Combinations==
'''Yegdrion''' can be put to use in the Stamina Combination '''Yegdrion''' [[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Cross|Cross]] [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]/[[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]]. The high Stamina of [[Disc - 2|2]]/[[Disc - 4|4]]/[[Disc - 7|7]] [[Frame - Glaive|Glaive]]/[[Frame - Cross|Cross]] synergizes with '''Yegdrion'''<nowiki/>'s own and [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]/[[Driver - Atomic|Atomic]] further bolsters Stamina due to their low friction. This Combination is capable of Out-Spinning most of the popular Stamina/Defense Combinations but is highly vulnerable against Attack Combinations.

}}{{Translation|'''Yggdrasil'''|ユグドラシル|Yugudorashiru}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of B-31 Starter, [[Yggdrasil Ring Gyro]], on February 20th, 2016.

==Description==
<onlyinclude>
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the world tree, Yggdrasil. A right-spin Stamina Type Layer with four blades placed on the outer circumference that generate centrifugal force and keep the Beyblade rotating for a long time.
|speaker = Official Description}}
Takara Tomy's '''Yggdrasil''' is a Stamina Type Layer named after Yggdrasil, the tree of life in Norse mythology, however to represent the anime’s rendition of this Layer’s beast, two dragon heads are present on either side near the center of the Layer.

It is a square-shaped Layer with two Dragon heads and two sloped blades meant to represent dragon claws on each side which make up the primary points of contact of this Layer. There are two small notches on either side of the Layer giving it a rough perimeter, which may imply high recoil but the protrusions are too shallow and produce only moderate recoil in practice.

Most of the weight of '''Yggdrasil''' is focused on its perimeter. While this may imply high Stamina potential, the square shape and rough perimeter of the Layer produces recoil which diminishes the Stamina of the Layer in battle, making it outclassed by Layers like [[Layer - Deep Chaos|Deep Chaos]] and [[Layer - Screw Trident|Screw Trident]], Stamina-wise. While the sloped blades may imply Destabilizing potential, the angle is too shallow and so they serve no purposes other than creating recoil. The recoil produced by the its shape is very low to be useful for Attack Combinations. Further more, '''Yggdrasil''' features four teeth of short length which are unable to handle its recoil making it extremely prone to losses by Burst.</onlyinclude>

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Yggdrasil''' is outclassed for Stamina by many other Layers and incurs Self-Bursts far too easily. While it can act as a consistent counter against [[Layer - Xcalibur|Xcalibur]], with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, that niche use is no longer viable.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Yggdrasil is recommended for collection purposes only.'''

}}{{Translation|'''Zillion Zeus'''|ジリオンゼウス|Jirion Zeusu}} is a [[Layer]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Dual Layer System]]. It debuted in Japan with the release of the B-59 Starter, [[Zillion Zeus Infinity Weight]], on September 17th, 2016.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote = The motif is of the almighty god, Zeus. The Layer's built-in metal balls move in and out at a high and low speed to maintain proper balance.
|speaker = Official Description}}
<onlyinclude>Takara Tomy's '''Zillion Zeus''' is a Stamina Type Layer that bears a slight elliptical shape, two "Z"s on either side and two faces on either side, meant to represent its Layer's namesake, Zeus, the god of thunder in Greek Mythology. Unlike most Layers of the Dual Layer System, '''Zillion Zeus''' features a gimmick; it features two metal balls on tracks akin to the GB145 Spin Track from Metal Fight Beyblade.

Due to centrifugal force, the metal balls move farther towards the edge of the Layer's tracks. In theory, this is meant to increase its Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and Flywheel Effect, which increases Stamina. However in practice, the weight of the distance traveled by the metal balls is too small to create a significant effect.

The six blades of its perimeter are placed symmetrically, four of which are sloped. This means that half of the time, the pointed front and back edges will make contact with the opponent's Layer. The relatively heavy weight of the large blades with the elliptical shape creates high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) which grants high Stamina retention and Burst Resistance, capable of compensating for the average teeth of '''Zillion Zeus'''. While this is somewhat reduced by the recoil inherent in elliptical shapes, the Layer's teeth are capable of compensating for this, and the recoil '''Zillion Zeus''' creates grants Attack potential, making it an excellent Layer for Balance Combinations.

However, the impact on the back edges has lead to numerous reported cases of breaks with no mold variations released to solve that problem. As such it is recommended to own multiple copies of this Layer and to be prepared to replace it.</onlyinclude>

==Use in Balance Combinations==
'''Zillion Zeus''' can be put to use in the Balance Combination '''Zillion Zeus''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]/[[Disc - Down|Down]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]] [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]/[[Driver - Trans|Trans]]. The Stamina of '''Zillion Zeus''' is bolstered by [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]]/[[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]/[[Disc - Down|Down]]/[[Disc - Spread|Spread]] and [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]]/[[Driver - Trans|Trans]]. [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] adds Knock-Out Defense and bolsters '''Zillion Zeus'''<nowiki/>' Attack potential. [[Disc - Knuckle|Knuckle]]/[[Disc - Down|Down]] and [[Driver - Orbit|Orbit]] bolsters Burst Resistance. [[Driver - Trans|Trans]] can make the Combination switch between Stationary Stamina and Mobile Stamina/Attack.

==Use in Attack Combinations==
'''Zillion Zeus''' can be put to use in the Attack Combination '''Zillion Zeus''' [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]]. The elliptical shape of '''Zillion Zeus''' creates Attack potential that is bolstered by the heavy weight of [[Disc - Heavy|Heavy]]/[[Disc - Gravity|Gravity]] while Burst Resistance is bolstered by the low friction of [[Driver - Accel|Accel]]/[[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] which allows this Combination to either Burst or slow down its opponent.

==Overall==
Takara Tomy's '''Zillion Zeus'''<nowiki/>' relatively high weight, high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD) and recoil inducing shape made it an excellent choice for Balance Combinations. However like other "Jack-of-all-Trades" parts, '''Zillion Zeus''' does not perform as consistently as a dedicated Attack, Defense or Stamina Layer. Furthermore with the release of the SwitchStrike/God Layer System, '''Zillion Zeus''' has become too light to remain competitive.

'''As such, Takara Tomy's Zillion Zeus is recommended for collection purposes only.'''<nowiki/>

parts.title: Takara Tomy
parts.text:
[[File:TT.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Current logo used since the merger in 2006.]]
{{Translation|'''Tomy Company Ltd.'''|株式会社タカラトミー|Kabushikigaisha Takara Tomī}}, also known as '''Takara Tomy''' is a Japanese toy company and the distributor and manufacturer of the ''[[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]]'' toyline in Japan. They currently host Beyblade tournaments in Japan. The company's headquarters is in Katsushika, Tokyo.

Tomy (founded in 1924 as Tomiyama, changing the name to Tomy in 1963) and long-time rival, Takara (founded in 1955), merged on March 1, 2006. Before the merger, Beyblades (particularly those of the ''[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade]]'' series) were manufactured by '''Takara'''.

[[Youngtoys]] (and previously [[Sonokong]]) licenses the toyline for distribution and manufacturing in South Korea, while [[Hasbro]] licenses the toyline for distribution and manufacturing internationally, particularly in western countries.
